items.title: Switch 2 黑色星期五《最终幻想 7 重制版 Intergrade》和《重生》价格均创历史新低
items.summary: Amazon's Black Friday deals have dropped Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade and Rebirth to record-low prices on

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/21/final-fantasy-7-remake-nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-cover-1795278604680.jpg

Any Nintendo Switch 2 owners who’ve been keen to catch up on the last two Final Fantasy 7 games in the Remake trilogy before FF7 Revelation can now grab both physical games for under £50, thanks to a surprise couple of big Black Friday deals.

At Amazon UK right now, you can buy the game card Nintendo Switch 2 ports of Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade for only £22.95 (normally £27.95) and Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth for just £25 (brought down by 37% from £39.95).
Save Big On Final Fantasy 7 Remake Titles For Switch 2

Those are not only the lowest prices we've seen for both boxed games on Amazon yet (confirmed by us at IGN UK), but this Switch 2 version of FF7 Rebirth is also the previously limited edition with the exclusive ‘Zack Fair’ Magic: The Gathering card .

As for FF7 Remake, the Intergrade version you get with the Switch 2 port is essentially the ‘Complete Edition’ of the game: adding performance improvements, a photo mode, a new superboss, an extra difficulty setting, and — most importantly — the Episode INTERmission story DLC featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

To clarify, however, whilst these are both indeed physical versions of the two Final Fantasy 7 Remake games, the game cartridges supplied in the case are Game-Key Cards — meaning no game data is kept on each card, and needs to be entirely downloaded to your Nintendo Switch 2 console via the internet.

So, you’ll need to be sure your internal storage has enough space for either or both games as you play: the file sizes being 90.4GB for Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade and 91.5 GB for Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth .

That said, to reiterate, Game-Key Cards are still reusable items and are a step-up from digital games shipped as a code in a box, such as GTA 6 skipping a disc release to be a purely digital-only game . As they still come in the form of physical cartridges, you will still be able to later resell, trade in, or lend out your copies of FF7 Remake Intergrade and Rebirth after you’ve finished playing them — if you so wish.

items.title: 借助 Argos 的技巧，你已经可以以不到 50 英镑的价格获得《Tloz Ocarina of Time Remake》的实体副本 - 方法如下
items.summary: The physical Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is already £49.99 at Argos with a simple discount trick, and you mi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/22/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-physical-under-50-deal-cover-1795368537407.jpg

Barely three weeks after The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time arrived on Nintendo Switch 2 , in true Black Friday fashion, there's already a handy, simple way to grab the physical version of the remake of Link’s classic Hyrule adventure for under £50 — and it doesn't involve buying from a third-party seller or settling for a digital copy.

Although Argos currently has the remake of Ocarina of Time listed for £54.99 , you can actually bring that down to just £49.99 by taking advantage of the retailer's £5 marketing promotion for when spending £40 or more, making the game 9% cheaper with a quick sign-up.

For comparison, that makes Argos the cheapest for the cartridge version of the game compared to other standard retailers — like Amazon UK charging £54.99 , whilst ShopTo has also been offering it for £54.85 .
How To Get Ocarina of Time for £49.99 at Argos
To claim the discount, you'll first need to visit Argos' email marketing sign-up page , enter your name and email address, and agree to receive its promotional communications.
After receiving your £5 voucher by email, simply add the boxed version of the Ocarina of Time remake to your Argos basket and apply the code at checkout, reducing the final cost to £49.99.

The only catch is that this offer is exclusively for customers who haven't already signed up for Argos marketing; thankfully, this means you can get around the issue by merely signing up with an alternate email address.
Also keep in mind that Argos usually charges £4.95 for delivery on orders below £100, but you can still keep the price below £50 by selecting free Click & Collect instead.

Better yet, numerous customers on HotUKDeals have reported receiving the special first-print foil-cover edition from Argos, with confirmations appearing as recently as November 17; this might be dependant on available stock at each branch or distribution centre, however, so don’t take that as a guarantee.

items.title: 粉丝制作的 iPhone 版 GTA 5 端口在两次停止后关闭
items.summary: A cease and desist from Rockstar parent company Take-Two has put an end to a fan-made port of GTA 5 for Apple

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/30/gta-5-michael-gta-6-1788126987774.png
A cease and desist from Rockstar parent company Take-Two has put an end to a fan-made port of GTA 5 for Apple devices a month after the creator went public with it.

Five Star Port launched in October this year as a full native port that ran locally on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. On newer hardware like the A20 Pro chip, the port boasted frame rates between 40 and 60fps at near-native resolution and max graphics settings. It also supported foldable phones, with the controllers and map appearing on the lower portion and the game on the upper portion of the screen.

Kevin, the creator of the port, posted a farewell message to the unofficial port’s website . “GTA V has always been one of my favorite games,” he said. “I've made mods for it, worked with FiveM, managed and hosted FiveM servers, and played on plenty of others. It has given me a lot of great memories. Getting to bring it to people who don't have a PC or a console, so they could play it on a phone, has been really, really cool. I honestly never thought this game could run on a phone at all.
“Take-Two Interactive, through their lawyers, has sent me a cease and desist asking me to stop all activity under the Five Star Port name and everything related to it. I am complying with it.”
Five Star Port’s website, app, and online services were shut down immediately. The Telegram and Discord groups have been made read-only and will be deleted on November 27.

“I'm not involved in and don't endorse any continuation, rebrand or copy of the port, and I can't help with files or links,” Kevin added. He also posted a warning that scammers have been passing around copies of the port, claiming to have a “new version” of it. These could spread computer viruses.

“Thank you again to everyone who supported this project: everyone who playtested, everyone who sent suggestions and feedback, and everyone who helped make it a great port that is actually fully playable on an iPhone,” Kevin signed off. “That still feels wild to me.”

Take-Two has a history of forcing fan projects offline, so perhaps it comes as no surprise to see Five Star Port fall by the wayside. The company is currently battling homebrew efforts to vibecode a PC port of GTA 6 , which some believe is mere days away from being playable.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: GTA 6 太简单了吗？摇滚明星参与其中
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and one of the things people are talking about is the game's difficulty le

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and one of the things people are talking about is the game's difficulty level . Some are saying it's too easy. Rockstar boss Rob Nelson has now entered the conversation, telling Destructoid that Rockstar's data showed that GTA 4 was "a little too punishing in places" and GTA 5 was "perhaps too easy." So with GTA 6, the team trying to "land somewhere in the middle."

GTA 6 has no defined difficulty levels , which is in keeping with the franchise's tradition. That said, players can adjust things like aiming controls, while players can unlock cheat codes to make the game easier or harder.
Design producer Scott Mitchell, meanwhile, said the fail states in GTA 6 were designed to feel "appropriate."

“We wanted to keep things open and not limit the players’ use of mechanics, such as stealth, but we did also want to make sure we retained the cinematic, high production value, explosive sequences that we’re known for, and people expect. It feels like we’ve managed to strike a good balance," he explained.

Also in the interview, Nelson said figuring out the difficulty level for GTA 6 is itself challenging because the designers themselves know enemy positions better than anyone after playing and testing the game so much.

"There’s a real process in unpicking some of that to create an experience most players will be able to enjoy, rather than endure," Nelson said. "The game is so big, and has such a wide range of content that we can really lean into that, making certain open-world content--compounds and fronts for example---more difficult, to give players seeking a challenge something to sink their teeth into as well.”
GTA 6 launched on November 19 and had a gigantic debut, selling 32.5 million copies by launch and generating around $4 billion on day one.
For more, check out GameSpot's GTA 6 review and our rundown of five things to do first.

items.title: R星封杀《GTA6》PC民间版!今日游民最热新闻大汇总
GTA 6：这就是为什么你应该在第一章之后回到杰森的房子
items.summary: Here’s why you should go back to Jason’s house after chapter 1 of GTA 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/25/jasons-house-blog-1795620048543.jpg
Warning: spoilers for Chapter 1 of GTA 6 follow.

If you’ve played through chapter one of GTA 6, you’ll know that Jason’s home isn’t in the best of shape following its final mission. On fire, and certainly no place to raise a child, the crib, coffee table, and all of your chosen home improvements are left either shattered or cindered by the time Lucia escapes, taking with her only one valuable: a photo of the couple’s son, Tomás. But not all is lost, and it’s worth going back to check what remains.

From the beginning of chapter two onward, going back to Jason’s waterside house can be a risky move to make. Flick open the map, and you’ll see a red area surrounding his immediate neighbourhood that signifies a police presence in the area. Of course, you’re free to head back straight away, but you’ll see a few cop cars sat outside his home, with a few people waiting in case you do return to the scene of the crime. Sneak past them if you trust your stealth skills, or opt for a much quicker and violent smash-and-grab maneuver if that’s more your style.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/25/police-jasons-house-1795620559389.jpg

If you're patient, though, that heat will eventually diminish over the course of the story, so you can walk straight through the front door. I’m not exactly sure if that’s tied to your progress through GTA 6’s main missions, or the in-game clock itself, but I can confirm that from around halfway through chapter three, that red zone had disappeared for me.

Once inside the ashen remains of Jason’s former quiet life, there are a couple of items of note to grab hold of. Both of these can be found under the floorboards of the bedroom where Jason’s stash once lay hidden. While you won’t be able to recover all of the money you stored there before realising it would be gone forever — I guess it burned, whereas the metal tin next to it protected its contents — you can find both his personal collection of photos and a rainy day fund worth $5,000.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/25/stash-photos-1795620585870.jpg

The former is a nice extra wrinkle to the story, as Jason and Lucia will make sure to cherish these photos, alongside the one she recovered of Tommy, and carry them with them from home to home around Leonida on their nomadic adventures. The latter is no small amount when starting again from scratch at the outset of chapter two, which does make the risk of getting busted worth it to get a head start in Port Gellhorn. Wait until chapter three, as I did, and that amount of money makes less of a difference.

But that isn’t all. When Lucia grapples with the two masked men who set the home on fire, Jason’s pet snake, Dolores, makes a daring escape when her glass enclosure is smashed. We saw her head for the door, but are left wondering whether she managed to dance through the flames to safety. Well, when returning to the home, make sure to check under the back steps, where you can find our serpentine friend alive and well. And she’s not alone either. Get a closer look to find her curled up around some eggs, signalling a whole host of mini Dolores’s are on the way. Perhaps they’ll rebuild this home together, and turn the whole of Key Lento into a snake town over time. Far-fetched, perhaps, but have you seen some of the bonkers sh*t happening in this game?
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/25/dolores-eggs-1795620599836.jpg

It’s just one example of how Rockstar has managed to build out the world of GTA 6 so successfully, making it feel like a place that carries on living even when you’re not there. This sort of thing is littered throughout Leonida as you progress through the story and the passing of time takes effect. Road and building works that start out as mounds of dirt slowly become more developed as chapters go by, with pipes being laid down and bricks stacked.

And Jason’s house isn’t the only place he and Lucia call home that’s worth revisiting long after they’ve departed. The Startlet Motel from chapter two also changes, offering new gameplay and story opportunities. GTA 6 is a game that rewards curiosity, often answering your questions with a satisfying answer, and returning to Jason’s home is just one example of it.

Team Cherry has now announced a special presentation to unveil more details, and you won't have to wait very long.

The studio has announced a "Cherry Time" for November 27 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET . The presentation promises "a bunch of exciting announcements, and an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow." The stream is already available with a countdown, so to tune in you can come right back here and watch below.

Sea of Sorrow will be the first major expansion for Hollow Knight: Silksong, and it will be free for all players. As the name suggests, it will have an aquatic theme, featuring new areas to explore and new tools to do it with.

Hollow Knight: Silksong itself was a critical success, scoring a 90 Metacritic average and being named one of GameSpot's Best Games of 2025 . Now that it's out, though, we have to start donning our clown noses for other perennial no-show game reveals .

items.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》中最愚蠢的争议是对杰森购买露西亚花的愤怒
items.summary: Some corners of the internet are furious Rockstar has apparently turned its crime simulator into a game about

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/1a20f72012888-screenshoturl-1-1795555585310.jpg

Of all the things I expected Grand Theft Auto 6 to cause arguments about, whether or not a man should buy his girlfriend flowers was pretty low on the list. Yet some corners of the internet are furious that Rockstar has apparently turned its crime simulator into a game about being a considerate boyfriend, while others are discovering that Jason Duval might just be the perfect man – a sentence I never thought I’d write about a Grand Theft Auto protagonist.

As well as the usual GTA activities of stealing cars, shooting people, and generally being a menace to society, GTA 6 gives players the option to nurture the relationship between its two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. It's especially prevalent at the start of the game, where you can renovate their home, buy Lucia flowers, pick out clothes and accessories for her while shopping, bring her drinks, open car doors, and even hold her hand while walking around Leonida. I think it's all rather sweet, especially when you consider that these two are also quite happy to commit armed robberies together. Couples who crime together, stay together. (That's not a spoiler; that's me high on hopium as I play through the story.)

Crucially, all of this romantic housekeeping is optional. The game certainly prompts you to nurture the relationship, especially early on when we're just finding out who Jason and Lucia are. But when the button-press to hold hands or show affection pops up, you're free to ignore it. Over time, this will cause the relationship to cool to the point where eventually they become platonic partners in crime, but they're still very much in it together.

Showing affection is also not specific to Jason either – once you're through Chapter 1, which is heavily focused on the army vet, and deeper into the game where you spend more time as both characters, they can both choose to show the other affection – or not, if you so desire. You choose how much effort they want to put into Jason and Lucia’s relationship, and the game responds accordingly. You can make them the sort of disgustingly loved-up couple who make everyone around them feel slightly ill, or let their relationship cool into something more businesslike. No one is being forced to play house.

From a quick browse of social media, and, in particular, X, you'll see posts reading, "RIP GTA. Killed by women. Like so many before," from @trackthedecline. User @ExoGhost writes, "GTA 6 has a mission where you need to buy flowers for Lucia. This game is such woke slop. It's so obvious it was made by women." And then there's @5jmxgz, who claims, "gta 6 lowk the biggest flop ever, we waited 13 years for a literal cuck simulator."
Grand Theft Auto 6 cemented itself as the most successful entertainment launch of all-time , making $3.79 billion in just one day.

For some players, the problem seems to be that they’ve waited 13 years for a new GTA game, only to find themselves assembling furniture and picking up groceries. There’s a reasonable argument buried somewhere in there about whether mundane domestic activities are what people want from a series built on criminal excess and absolute freedom. If you spend your actual life doing chores, perhaps coming home to do more of them in a video game isn’t particularly appealing? The pace of Chapter 1 feels like deliberate decision from Rockstar to subvert what people expect from GTA, and I think it's that that's causing at least some of the reaction, because once you move onto Chapter 2 and beyond, the only chores you're really doing is putting cups in the sink, opening car doors, and getting your significant other a snack now and again. No one is cleaning the oven or pulling lint out of the dryer.

However, some of the complaints go considerably further, treating the idea of Jason showing any kind of affection or consideration for Lucia as an attack on masculinity itself. Some have described the game as a “cuck simulator” while reacting to Jason running errands for Lucia. Apparently, buying your girlfriend something nice is now a threat to civilization. Someone should probably warn the florists.

For me, GTA 6 is Rockstar at its subversive best. While internet conflict raged over whether or not games were getting too “woke” and that the heroes were becoming too “soft,” Rockstar gave us a strong, straight, masculine guy with a hot girlfriend. The only catch? You have to put in the work that goes with that. You need to put effort into the relationship to keep the hot girlfriend, you need to go to the gym to stay buff, you need to contribute to the household finances.

Some X users are seeing the positives in Jason and Lucia's dynamic, and the warmth shared between them. "When he said 'you and Tommy are the only family I need', then went ahead to include her mom because he knows how important she is to her. Yep Jason Duval is not just a green flag but the greenest forest," says @keiuzuki. It's a sentiment shared by many others, who are already creating collages, montages, and memes dedicated to Mr Duval.

For plenty of female players, Jason’s appeal isn’t just that he’s attractive, capable, or willing to commit a little light felony in the name of love. It’s that he pays attention. He notices things. He makes an effort. And while the bar for romantic male behavior probably shouldn’t be somewhere around buying flowers and remembering to open a car door, there’s something undeniably appealing about a game that makes those little gestures feel important. The man has a criminal record, questionable career prospects, and presumably several outstanding warrants, but at least he remembers to buy you a lemonade.

There’s also a particularly funny subset of women watching their real-life partners enthusiastically renovate a fictional house, buy fictional flowers, and take their fictional girlfriend shopping, while wondering when exactly that energy might make its way into their actual relationship. Imagine watching your husband spend three hours choosing the perfect paint color for a woman made of polygons while the dishwasher has needed emptying since Tuesday.

Others have even suggested that GTA 6 is having a positive effect on their relationships, with men apparently taking inspiration from Jason’s behavior and becoming more thoughtful partners themselves. Rockstar may have inadvertently created the world’s most expensive couples’ therapy.

"My husband has been playing GTA 6 and took a break to run to the get food," tells Threads user monroecammack. "He came back with ice cream and flowers for me and said 'if I have to get Lucia flowers, then I have to get flowers for you too' and I - ." One reply humurously replied with, "OMG THAT IS WHY MY HUSBAND RANDOMLY GOT ME FLOWERS YESTERDAY."

And perhaps that’s the most interesting thing about this whole argument. GTA has always been about giving players the freedom to indulge in fantasies, whether that’s becoming a criminal kingpin, owning an absurd collection of supercars, or escaping the police in increasingly ridiculous ways. GTA 6 simply adds another fantasy to the list: being in a loving, functional relationship, which is truly the most unrealistic thing Rockstar has ever put in one of its games.

items.title: 与 PlayStation 达成新协议后，《巫师 4》将不再是 PS5 独占游戏
items.summary: CD Projekt Red and Sony Interactive Entertainment just announced a marketing deal for The Witcher 4 , but that

content.v: CD Projekt Red and Sony Interactive Entertainment just announced a marketing deal for The Witcher 4 , but that doesn't mean the game will be exclusive to PlayStation.
CD Projekt Red's Michał Nowakowski said on social media , "Just to be clear: The Witcher 4 and our other upcoming titles will remain multiplatform."
The marketing deal could be similar to the one between Rockstar and Sony for GTA 6, where GTA 6 was given preferential treatment on PS5 in a number of ways in the marketing campaign.

Beyond The Witcher 4, CD Projekt Red is making Cyberpunk 2 , a new IP codenamed Hadar , a new game believed to be a multiplayer The Witcher title , and a remake of the original Witcher . On the mobile side, CD Projekt Red is working with Scopely on a new game that hasn't been announced yet.

The Witcher 4 now has more than 500 people working on it , and the game is expected to release in 2028. Given that timing, The Witcher 4 likely won't be on a disc because Sony won't support game discs beginning in January 2028.
That being said, CD Projekt Red is promising that The Witcher 4 will have some kind of physical goodies for fans.
In other news about The Witcher 4, CD Projekt Red recently discussed the game in comparison to GTA 6.

"Of course we did look at the game; we did see the differences. We believe there’s going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4–I think so, yes," Nowakowski said . "It’s been 11 years; we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4.”

items.title: Cassette Beasts 2002 预览：一款明显的英国风格且令人印象深刻的生物收集角色扮演游戏
items.summary: After playing through Cassette Beasts 2002’s opening hours for this preview, I kept playing. While I can’t tal

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/18/multiplayer2-1795030852818.png
Key Preview Takeaways:

After playing through Cassette Beasts 2002’s opening hours for this preview, I kept playing. While I can’t talk about what I’ve seen since wrapping up the first chunk of my adventure, its opening hours made a strong first impression. I’m charmed by Bytten Studio’s beast design, writing, and distinct take on the creature-collecting RPG. It’s scratching the catch-n-battle itch I get this time of year, and I don’t see that changing anytime soon.

Lately, I’ve been glued to an online battle simulator from another creature collecting RPG series. Just hopelessly hooked. So when a game like Cassette Beasts gives me an opportunity to stop tugging at the slot machine arm of randomized browser-bound battle teams and build one, I turn my head and pay attention.

Cassette Beasts 2002 made the most of my embattled attention span. Its battle system takes a lot of what I love about Pokemon and Persona and goes a little deeper on some of the ideas that drive the rock-paper-scissors type advantages. For example, water-based attacks will rust metal, weakening metallic Beasts’ defenses. Some attacks might cause Resonance on a metal creature, which automatically knocks it out once enough stacks build up.

I love this approach to type advantages, which capitalizes on strategy in a cool way. The fact that I can just stack Resonance a few times creates a mini-objective in battle that goes beyond just finding the best type advantage. Chasing these objectives adds a lot more depth to this style of turn-based combat that I absolutely adore.

So does the Fusion system, which lets any two Beasts combine into one powerful critter. This is one of the most impressive mechanics I’ve seen in this kind of game. I’m no mathematician, but with over 200 Beasts on the roster (more than 120 are new, by the way), that leaves room for a staggering number of different combinations. While I only saw a small handful of the available Fusions, these super-powered Beasts gain four action points each turn to spend on special moves and abilities in battle, rather than the standard two.

Set in 2000’s London, Cassette Beasts 2002 is unmistakably British. As an American who hasn’t been to the United Kingdom, I’m positive some cultural references and quips have flown over my head, but I still caught a few. For example, the first area in the dream world occupied by the eponymous tape critters (Nodol) is called Bethnal Blue, rather than Bethnal Green.

Naturally, my understanding starts and ends with knowing these names, so I can’t really speak to the actual location or twist Cassette Beasts 2002 is trying to bring to it. Still, that nod to an East London neighborhood feels at home next to references to the works of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle and The Bard. Recent news has me holding out for a Fleming nod.

The world Cassette Beasts 2002 occupies feels as alive as it does tuned to its time and place. Through the course of my demo, I made friends with the locals, bought coffee from the local convenience store worker, and met my exhausted, drink-slinging counterpart across the pond. Brought to life by charming writing and talented voice acting, each character felt believable and interesting enough to actually stop and talk to.

Walking around town reminded me of going outside in my own neighborhood and bumping into a neighbor or bar regular. Maybe this was all canned stuff, designed to fill out and flatter the first part of the game, but the skill trees I saw for some of my digital neighbors suggest otherwise.

Completing sidequests in Nodol, searching in the right places, or progressing in the story will net you Seeds of Inspiration, which you use to fill out the nodes on these NPCs’ skill trees. Each tree represents something different. The shopkeeper’s path gates off helpful items like better healing for your Beasts, whereas my new friend Sai’s skill tree offers upgrades that improve both his skills in battle and helpful upgrades to things like the buffs gained from eating food in-battle.

It would be silly to talk about a game called Cassette Beasts in which you literally record the creatures you’re capturing without mentioning its soundtrack. I heard roughly an EP’s worth of music across the three-hour demo. It’s a small sample size for what’s probably going to be a 20-ish-hour game if the previous Cassette Beasts’ HowLongToBeat page is any indication, but it left a good impression. My favorite stuff showed up in boss fights against foes like Copskin, but the overworld theme for Bethnal Blue was as chill as the snow-capped mountains. I’m sure the best stuff is reserved for late-game boss fights.

Cassette Beasts 2002 promises a nostalgic trip to an era of tape decks and payphones. Built on a clever, distinct battle system that goes beyond just rock, paper, scissors and set in a charming, lived-in world, I’ll probably keep my Steam Deck nearby for a few days to come. It’s slated for release in March of next year, so it’ll be a while before you can get your hands on this one. But it’s just as well; you’re probably going to be pretty busy with another game in which the soundtrack is heavily emphasized for the next few months.

items.summary: GTA 6 has no shortage of forces trying to put a damper on your crime spree, but the long arm of the law might

content.v: GTA 6 has no shortage of forces trying to put a damper on your crime spree, but the long arm of the law might be the least of your worries if you're planning a successful caper in Vice City. As players have discovered, the greatest threat to a clean getaway might just be an impressive mural, as they've smashed their vehicles right into an unforgiving wall that looks like it was ripped straight out of a Road Runner cartoon.

Located in Vice City's Decor District, this piece of street art resembles a tunnel going under the nearby overpass, and at high speed, it's pretty convincing--something I discovered to my dismay, totaling my pretty sweet muscle car in the process. Does anyone have an industrial-strength magnet so that I can start working out these dents?
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/1a21313039a98-screenshotUrl.jpg?w=636

It's a delicious bit of trolling from Rockstar Games: the kind of design choice that would make Looney Tunes legend Tex Avery proud with how effective it is. Numerous players have been caught out, and this is just one of many little secrets and Easter eggs hidden in the game. Fortunately, a gas station was nearby, and my muscle car limped to it for a quick repair.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/1a21313263d79-screenshotUrl.jpg?w=636

As GTA 6 prepares to celebrate its first record-breaking week of release, players have made plenty of discoveries. The Bigfoot mystery has been solved , you can hop into a portal to visit Vice City during the '80s , and there's even an island where bored rich people will hunt you . For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

items.title: GTA 6 模组制作者正尝试对 PC 端口进行 Vibe 编码，但进展并不顺利
items.summary: PC modders are racing to get GTA 6 playable on PC after the leak of the game's complete Xbox build , but so fa

content.v: PC modders are racing to get GTA 6 playable on PC after the leak of the game's complete Xbox build , but so far it doesn't look too promising.

GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive and developer Rockstar Games haven't been sitting idle either, as one of the leads behind the Project Leonida Discord group claimed in now-deleted social media posts that they were stepping away from the mammoth task of getting GTA 6 to run on PC. Project Leonida has also been taken down, but it's not the only group trying to get GTA 6 running outside of PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

None of these groups have succeeded yet, and as Twitter user Chasm detailed online , maybe relying heavily on AI tools isn't the way to go. Dev streams have been full of users leveraging generative AI tools to do something , with several prompts being absolute gems of wishful thinking. Here's a snippet of what people have been throwing at Google's Antigravity, while butchering the English language:

Even with an army of enthusiasts throwing prompts and cash at generative AI, a copied version of GTA 6 still seems far out of reach. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick commented in March that the idea of using AI and simply pushing a button to make a hit game was "laughable," and he referenced the music industry, which is grappling with a flood of AI slop to top streaming platforms. "Right now [in music] there are programs that allow you to put out a prompt and get a professionally recorded song spit back out at you. It sounds like a song, but I defy you to listen to it more than once. It's great to send as a greeting card to your partner on their birthday, but that's about it," Zelnick said.

Whatever progress is made in the GTA 6 PC port scene, don't expect it to last long before Take-Two's lawyers pounce. The publisher hasn't shied away from protecting its IP in the past, and takedown notices for any future GTA 6-related projects seem likely. In related GTA 6 news, you can read up on how the game has given Pornhub a hard time and how it became the biggest launch in PlayStation history .

items.title: 就连马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 也陷入了《GTA 6》的狂热之中，在赢得拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前的 40 个小时内
items.summary: What's your excuse?

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/max-verstappen-gta-6-1795564044448.jpg
Famous Dutch-Belgian race driver Max Verstappen revealed that he’d spent the weekend of the Las Vegas Grand Prix locked in to GTA 6, saying he played over 40 hours of the game.

Everyone’s got GTA 6 fever, including Max Verstappen. Not even the Las Vegas Grand Prix could stop him from causing virtual chaos in Vice City, which he says he spent more than 40 hours doing during the weekend of the race.
Verstappen nonchalantly dropped this nugget of information during a live stream the following week, saying he would play the game in the mornings and evenings in between his duties on the track.
“I played a lot in the evening and in the morning in Vegas,” Verstappen explained. “I mean, I can’t go out anyways and walk around.”
The driver also revealed that he’s been so focused on GTA 6 and driving real-life race cars that he’s “completely forgotten” how to play Minecraft, despite having a scheduled stream for it.
“I’m so bad when I play too many games at the same time. I can’t, I just can’t!” he joked.
🤯Max Verstappen played GTA VI for FORTY HOURS while in Las Vegas On top of that, he also won the race https://t.co/jwuxQnHxyS

The Las Vegas Grand Prix took place on November 19 - 21. Verstappen took first place in the prestigious Formula 1 race, beating out Britain’s Lando Norris and Australia’s Oscar Piastri. The race is around 50 laps long with a total race distance of 192.6 miles (309.96 kilometers), generally lasting around one and a half hours.

As revealed by the name, Grand Theft Auto is a game series that involves a lot of vehicles, and not just for carjacking; the latest entry in the franchise even features drag racing and mudding, a hobby common in the American countryside that involves the use of off-road vehicles racing through mud-covered areas or even specially-made racetracks.

It’s quite likely that Verstappen dabbled a bit in these side missions, though he says that he’s already beaten 80% of GTA 6’s story. In fact, the driver admitted that he has skipped most of the main cutscenes, calling them “too boring.”

Verstappen’s style of playing GTA 6 is one of several that we’ve seen over the weekend. In fact, many players are avoiding progressing the story in favor of spending time in Chapter 1, which sees Jason living the average life of a drug runner in Rockstar’s fictionalized version of the Florida Keys. Oddly, it’s a slow-paced, slice-of-life section of the game that some players haven’t left yet, preferring to take it easy diving for treasure, fishing with Cal, and soaking up the environment.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

content.v: 英伟达近年来卷入了不少争议，包括CEO黄仁勋因涉嫌和女性存在不正当关系而辞职，随后又重新回归公司。不过，无论这些风波如何，英伟达今年在游戏玩家群体中的口碑也明显下滑。原因在于，公司将更多资源优先投入AI领域，服务于那些AI行业巨头，导致显卡价格多次上涨，市场供应也持续紧张。
最新消息显示，英伟达计划在未来几个月进一步削减GPU供应。据报道，该公司已经通知中国地区的显卡合作伙伴（AIB），2026年第四季度消费级及游戏显卡的供应量将再次大幅减少20%至30%。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795612959_949193_jpg_r.jpg
消息来自中国知名科技论坛博板堂（Board Channels）。报道称，英伟达计划从2026年11月到2027年1月削减游戏显卡供应。此举不仅无助于缓解市场对显卡供应的担忧，反而可能进一步推高GPU价格，加剧RTX显卡缺货问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795612960_859378.jpg
此前，英伟达在2026年第三季度就已经收紧了面向中国市场的GPU供应。如今游戏显卡供应再次受到限制，意味着市场上能够买到的显卡将变得更加有限。
虽然报道没有明确指出此次削减供应涉及哪些RTX系列显卡，但外界普遍认为，受影响的很可能是RTX 5000系列。毕竟，在当前内存资源极度紧张的市场环境下，这类显卡对相关资源的需求也相当庞大。
目前，英伟达旗下的旗舰级RTX 5080显卡售价已经达到2000至3000美元。随着新一轮供应限制即将到来，这些显卡的价格恐怕还会进一步上涨。
值得注意的是，此次消费级GPU供应削减可能并不局限于中国市场，未来全球其他地区也有可能受到波及。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599749_817425_jpg_r.jpg
一些玩家说，当时没察觉主角有明显的挑衅举动。一位玩家称，他操作杰森向路人问好时，几乎每次都碰到冷脸。有些女性把招呼当成搭讪，有些男性则强硬地叫他走开。
讨论中，不少人拿《荒野大镖客：救赎2》作比较。亚瑟·摩根在路上打招呼时，有时能得到友善回应，或和对方聊上几句。部分玩家觉得，在罪城这么做更容易惹人厌烦。也有人碰上愿意搭话的居民，对方还让他摸了摸自己的狗。
有玩家猜测，所在街区、主角的穿着以及此前是否和对方打过交道，都可能影响路人的态度。这些猜测仍待开发者确认。
还有人把罪城居民的戒备解读为对当代佛罗里达的讽刺，并将这座现代 都市 与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》描绘的19世纪末美国作对比。部分玩家肯定了路人反应的细致程度，也希望街头对话里能多一些友善的回应。

items.title: CDPR：《巫师4》在技术上能像《GTA6》那样实现飞跃
items.summary: 《GTA6》全球发售还不到一周，但现在已经可以肯定，这款游戏成功超越了玩家此前的种种期待。截至目前，《GTA6》打破了多项纪录，成为游戏史上规模最大的娱乐产品首发，仅用不到一周时间就卖出了超过4500万份。无论是游戏媒体

content.v: CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6. While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way.

"Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences.

"Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4."

Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time.
Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JG6brzcCtL4wRDdMBaAvf6.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KuLEK2cmke8MvaewCLhme6.jpg

At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do."

He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason.

"You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero."

Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments."

"I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.'

"They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that."

Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.)

seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed
The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030.

content.v: Apple TV最成功的原创剧集之一即将回归。苹果已正式宣布续订《足球教练》第五季。在第四季创下平台首播收视纪录后，杰森·苏戴奇斯将继续与Apple TV合作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795600390_452016_jpg_r.jpg
《足球教练》原本可能在播出三季后就画上句号，但如今，这部剧已经成为苹果流媒体平台最重要的原创作品之一，短期内似乎还没有完结的打算。11月23日，苹果正式宣布续订第五季。
苹果给出的续订理由之一，是第四季取得了出色的成绩。官方称，第四季首播创下了平台纪录，不过并未公布具体的观看数据。主演杰森·苏戴奇斯将继续参与第五季制作，同时担任主演和执行制片人。
第四季对剧集原有的故事模式进行了一定程度的调整。泰德重新回到里士满，这一次，他接手的是一支征战英格兰第二级别联赛的女子足球队。除了加入新演员之外，汉娜·沃丁厄姆、朱诺·坦普尔和布雷特·戈德斯坦等多位熟悉的面孔也悉数回归。
《足球教练》已成为苹果的重要招牌作品
对苹果而言，续订《足球教练》的意义并不局限于剧集本身。与其他拥有庞大影视作品库的流媒体平台不同，Apple TV主要依靠原创内容吸引用户。因此，能够持续多年留住观众、让用户长期订阅的成熟剧集，对苹果来说尤其重要。
不过，第四季的上线过程也并非一帆风顺。该季大结局最初出现了配音缺失的问题，不仅缺少德语音轨，还同时缺失了另外10种语言的配音版本。
目前，苹果尚未公布《足球教练》第五季的具体播出时间，也没有透露新一季将讲述怎样的故事。不过，对于这位来自美国的足球教练及其粉丝来说，至少可以确定：泰德的故事还远没有结束。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 一名长期从事屋顶维修的《GTA6》玩家发现，杰森·杜瓦尔铺屋瓦的手法有问题，开玩笑说下次遇到大雨屋顶就会漏。他把这件事戏称为自己玩了25小时后发现的最大缺点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599176_437492_jpg_r.jpg
铺瓦是游戏里一项可选的房屋和屋顶维修活动。杰森铺起来看着挺轻松，但这名玩家指出，瓦片搭接过松，上层的位置又偏高，钉子只固定了所在的那一层。按他的说法，钉位应在切口上方约2至3厘米，让钉子同时穿过两层瓦，再由上层瓦片盖住钉位，避免雨水接触钉子。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599257_373643.jpeg
这名玩家自嘲，白天在现实里修完屋顶，回家打开游戏又看到杰森铺瓦，偏偏还铺错了。Rockstar另一部作品《荒野大镖客：救赎2》里的马匹也会对寒冷作出反应，这类细节曾让玩家讨论多年。
这名玩家说，自己玩了25小时仍在序章，大部分时间都花在探索游戏世界、参与活动和查看随机事件上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》成为2026年10月美国市场销量最高的游戏。《使命召唤》系列也由此连续第19年在新作首发月份登上销量榜首。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795601401_972245_jpg_r.jpg
市场研究机构Circana公布了美国电子游戏市场2026年10月的最新月度销售报告。在游戏销量方面，《使命召唤：现代战争4》成功登顶，成为当月美国最畅销的游戏。
值得注意的是，这意味着《使命召唤》系列已经连续第19年成为游戏发售首月销量冠军。这一纪录始于2008年11月，当时《使命召唤：世界战争》击败《吉他英雄：世界巡演》和《战争机器2》，成功登上销量榜首。
Circana还公布了主机游戏内容消费数据。与2026年10月相比，主机游戏内容消费额下降了18%。不过，这一比较本身就存在一定难度，因为2025年10月恰好有《战地6》和《宝可梦传说Z-A》两款重磅作品发售，拉高了当月的市场表现。
展望2026年11月，Rockstar旗下的《GTA6》毫无疑问将成为当月销量冠军，并且很可能最终成为2026年全年最畅销的游戏。毕竟，这款作品目前已经展现出了惊人的销售势头。

items.title: 《GTA6》砍了这么多玩法？买游艇飞机、打911全没了
items.summary: 《GTA6》在玩法设计上迎来了许多重大变化。除了取消任务重玩、不再“随心所欲”的无差别破坏、不能嫖妓等已被玩家注意到的改动外，…

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》相比前作删减或取消了不少玩法，包括购买飞机船只、拨打911、疯狂杀戮挑战和各种小游戏等。面对这些变化，你对哪项功能的缺席最不感到遗憾？
《GTA6》在玩法设计上迎来了许多重大变化。除了取消任务重玩、不再“随心所欲”的无差别破坏、不能嫖妓等已被玩家注意到的改动外，游戏中似乎还有不少细节变化尚未引起广泛关注。
近日，有博主对此进行了盘点，列出了《GTA6》相较前作的一些玩法缺失与调整。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611252004419422.png
首先，玩家无法像购买汽车一样正式购买船只和飞机。虽然可以通过偷窃的方式获得这些载具并临时使用，但无法将它们登记为永久拥有的个人载具。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611252006097755.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611252006106458.png
其次，游戏中似乎无法拨打911紧急电话。玩家只能通过手机联系通讯录中的联系人，不能像前作那样呼叫警察或救护车。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611252006022284.png
此外，《GTA6》还缺少前作中的“疯狂杀戮”（Rampage）挑战，也没有飞镖、保龄球等小游戏。电影院观影功能和大型游乐设施同样未能出现。
《GTA6》全收集地图上线 ，看它开局就能赚两万多，所有收集品、高跟鞋俱乐部、隐藏彩蛋位置都在这！
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/11/20/origin_202611200954402940.jpg

content.v: 一名玩家清点了《GTA6》中莱昂尼达的5588栋建筑，称其中1563栋可以进入。这一数字高于2025年6月流传的700多栋。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795600531_498885_jpg_r.jpg
早在《GTA6》发售之前，玩家就一直在猜测游戏中的莱昂尼达州究竟有多少建筑可以进入。如今，一位玩家专门对游戏中的建筑进行了统计，最终得出的数字超过了此前传闻的两倍，而此前的传闻数量已经让不少玩家觉得相当夸张。
2025年6月，我们曾报道过《GTA》知名爆料人士GameRoll的一则消息。据称，《GTA6》中将有超过700栋建筑可以进入。当时，不少玩家认为这个数字已经相当惊人，实际数量可能会低得多。然而，根据一位玩家的统计结果，实际情况甚至更加夸张：在统计的5588栋建筑中，据称有1563栋可以进入。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795600635_880224_jpg_r.jpg
不仅数量惊人，内部细节也令人赞叹
大量可以进入的建筑让玩家们感到十分惊喜。尽管这份统计数据目前很难得到独立验证，但社区中不少玩家认为这个数字完全有可能。相比建筑数量，更让玩家印象深刻的是，Rockstar对建筑内部细节的精心设计，以及这些内容为 开放世界 探索带来的乐趣。
讨论中获得最高点赞的一条评论，讲述了玩家探索一栋房屋的经历。这栋房屋虽然被标记为可以进入，但正门却无法打开。玩家绕着房子转了一圈后，意外发现后院灌木丛后面藏着一处地下室入口。这名玩家写道：“游戏会奖励那些愿意探索的玩家，这种感觉真的很棒。”
其他玩家还分享了自己的发现，包括不起眼的谷仓里藏着稀有车辆、隐藏的现金保险箱，以及私人住宅内各种奇怪的随机事件。
甚至有一位Reddit用户表示，自己偶然发现了罪恶城一家相对冷门的酒店，而这家酒店恰好是他现实生活中经常和妻子光顾的地方。游戏不仅还原了酒店大堂，还包括屋顶露台、游泳池和酒吧等区域。
事实上，在游戏发售之前，就已经有迹象表明，Rockstar曾以现实世界中的真实地点为原型设计部分建筑。对于那些目前仍然主要专注于主线剧情的玩家来说，不妨暂时放下任务，去莱昂尼达州的住宅、酒店、商店和仓库中四处逛逛，或许会有不少意外发现。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 从血统不纯到真香，这款美少女机甲新游有何魅力？
items.summary: 这款经典IP的新作，仍然有着很多足以吸引玩家的独特特质。

content.v: 很多《Muv-Luv》系列的老玩家，刚听到《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》公布时的心情，恐怕都像过山车一样复杂。
在很多人的印象里，《Muv-Luv》一直是一个以宏大世界观、残酷战争和深刻剧情著称的经典ADV系列。尤其是《Muv-Luv Alternative》，更是凭借着出色的角色塑造和出人意料的反转，被不少玩家捧上了“史上最强ADV”的神坛。
因此这款沉寂多年后终于到来的新作，按理说让玩家们欢呼雀跃。但《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》的卖相，看上去却有点不那么《Muv-Luv》——全新的角色全新的故事，生死存亡的残酷战争变成了充满青春气息的学园日常，就连玩法也从传统ADV变成了抽卡养成的全自动放置RPG。
点击前往《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》商店页
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/15757.jpg
这种大跨度的改变，自然也引来了不少系列老玩家的忧虑。有人担心制作组只是想借经典IP的名气整一个圈钱的流水线手游，也有人对本作大变的风格表示怀疑，毕竟抹布系列的魅力就在于其独特且沉重的故事基调。
不过，随着9月免费Demo开放，再到昨天游戏正式上线Steam，玩家们的风评也开始发生变化。丰富的玩法让很多冲着剧情来的老玩家惊喜。只是想找个美少女副游的玩家，也逐渐被游戏里的人物关系和剧情吸引。这款经典IP的新作，仍然有着很多足以吸引玩家的独特特质。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/40263.jpg
对于现在的玩家来说，生活里最不缺的，可能就是各种各样需要每天上线的游戏。而《少女庭园》的自动放置玩法，恰恰比较适合那些不愿意投入大量时间、却又想每天获得一点养成乐趣的玩家。
游戏采用了相当经典的放置RPG模式。玩家需要从收集到的角色中挑选五名组建队伍，再根据敌人的属性和战斗特点调整阵容。之后就可以把一切交给自动战斗了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/49031.jpg
虽然玩家不用自己操作，但本作丰富的角色定位、技能搭配和属性克制，依然提供了不少策略和养成的空间。比如有的角色擅长物理输出，有的主打EN伤害，还有坦克、辅助和控场等不同职责。面对打不过的敌人，换个阵容、调整一下站位，有时就能产生意想不到的效果。
实际上，在游戏上线后，也有不少玩家特别提到了角色属性与数值之间的联动，认为这套系统比表面看起来更有深度。除了常规推图外，《少女庭园》还加入了带有轻度Roguelite元素的迷宫探索模式，以及供玩家检验养成和配队结果的“官方MG竞技”和模拟战斗模式。这些玩法都在数值和养成体系的基础上丰富了可玩性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/55371.jpg
但这些策略养成要素和本作的轻量化体验并不冲突。如果你只是想要一款有养眼妹子的轻松副游，本作轻松的游戏节奏，绝对可以满足你的要求。
不过，如果问我《少女庭园》最值得关注的地方是什么，那答案还不是它的玩法，毕竟对很多身经百战的老玩家来说，本作的玩法就是经典的日式放置RPG的模板。真正让《少女庭园》在一众同类型游戏中脱颖而出的，还是《Muv-Luv》系列的老本行——剧情和角色塑造。
虽然《少女庭园》采用了独立世界线，但它并没有丢掉系列在角色塑造上的传统优势。本作讲述了一个失忆指挥官带领一群即将被退学的“问题少女”，走出低谷并在探索地下迷宫的冒险中成长的故事。
在Demo版中，本作就已经展现出了庞大的角色阵容。除了玩家带领的“星空乙女”小队外，还有很多来自不同学院不同队伍的少女们，都展现出了她们独特的人设和性格。几乎每个玩家都能从本作庞大的角色阵容中找到自己的心头好。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/65690.jpg
除此之外，游戏还准备了不同的剧情选项、角色好感度和专属故事，让玩家能够逐步深入了解自己喜欢的角色。而精致的角色卡面、Live2D动态演出，以及完整的日语配音，也让这种角色陪伴体验变得更加直观。
在上线后针对游戏的讨论中，游戏的美术、配音和音乐表现，也是大多数玩家比较认可的内容。对于角色养成游戏来说，这些东西的重要性其实不言而喻。毕竟，角色强度可以随着版本变化，但一个人设优秀，外形戳人喜好的角色，才能长久地赢得玩家的喜爱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/73710.jpg
更何况，《少女庭园》的剧情也没有因为更轻松的游戏风格，就完全放弃系列那股熟悉的味道。在美少女们嬉笑打闹的学园生活背后，仍然有神秘的地下迷宫、失忆的主角和有关世界末日预言的故事桥段。这些系列老玩家们似曾相识的情节，也让人对后续剧情的走向保持着好奇与期待。
在之前试玩过Demo版后，我对《少女庭园》最大的不满就是意犹未尽。星空乙女小队的故事刚刚展开，主角身世和地下迷宫的秘密开始浮出水面，剧情却突然戛然而止。好感度上限也被锁死，没法和喜欢的角色展开进一步的深入交流。也有一些玩过其他版本的老玩家，关心着游戏正式上线后的版本进度、更新速度和福利。
但好在，这些问题都已经能在《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》正式上线后得到答案。玩家可以继续推进故事、培养喜欢的角色。而且，本作此前已经在其它平台运营了一段时间。这也意味着，全球版玩家拥有一定的“千里眼”优势，能够通过其它平台此前推出的角色和活动，提前了解部分后续内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/91065.jpg
而在Steam版上线后，官方也为玩家们提供了量大管饱的福利。完成新手教程后，即可领取2000枚宝石、35张普通招募券、SSR角色必得招募券和SSR回忆必得券各1张，以及SSR角色「堂堂正正的傲娇小姐」绮罗克拉拉。这些资源能够帮助新人更快组建起自己的第一支队伍，也让玩家有机会在游戏初期就尝试不同的角色搭配。
另外，游戏还计划于12月1日开启与《Muv-Luv Alternative》的联动活动，鉴纯夏、御剑冥夜、珠濑壬姬等系列经典角色也将登场。对于等待已久的老玩家来说，能在这样一部风格不同的新作里，再次遇见熟悉的角色，多少也是一件值得期待的事情。
回过头来看，《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》从公布到正式上线所经历的争论，其实并不难理解。毕竟，对于一个拥有二十多年历史的经典IP来说，老玩家对《Muv-Luv》早就形成了对应的预期。因此突然改变玩法和基调的《少女庭园》，自然很难让所有人都立刻接受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261125_xjy_586_2/94446.jpg
但本作同样也有很多值得肯定的地方。对于愿意接受放置玩法的玩家来说，《少女庭园》提供了比较轻松的养成节奏，也保留了一定的策略和养成空间。
而对于更喜欢剧情与美少女角色的玩家来说，它的角色塑造、动态演出，以及逐渐展开的故事，同样有自己的吸引力。最重要的是，《少女庭园》本来就没有打算复刻《Alternative》那样的战争史诗。它只是选择了一种更加轻松的方式，把这个古老系列的魅力，重新呈现给如今的玩家。
《Muv-Luv 少女庭园》现已正式登陆Steam ，支持简体中文、繁体中文文本及日语配音，游戏本体免费游玩。如果你此前因为“血统不纯”而对它敬而远之，或者一直想找一款不用天天爆肝、又有角色和剧情可以慢慢品味的美少女游戏，那么不妨亲自体验一番。

items.title: RTX 5080单机测试《使命召唤：现代战争4》：621.35热修版平均帧率低19帧！
items.summary: 用户@x1lly在一台搭载GeForce RTX 5080的电脑上对比了两版NVIDIA驱动。运行《使命召唤：现代战争4》内置基准测试时，621.35热修版比617.42平均少19帧，输入延迟则低了1毫秒。这台电脑配备A

content.v: 用户@x1lly在一台搭载GeForce RTX 5080的电脑上对比了两版NVIDIA驱动。运行《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》内置基准测试时，621.35热修版比617.42平均少19帧，输入延迟则低了1毫秒。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795598788_642448.jpg
这台电脑配备AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D处理器。测试分辨率为2560×1440，开启DLSS性能模式。617.42测得平均288帧、输入延迟5毫秒，621.35热修版测得平均269帧、输入延迟4毫秒，平均帧率低约6.6%。
另一组测试使用搭载移动版GeForce RTX 4090的笔记本，驱动版本为617.42。游戏以2560×1600分辨率和最高画质运行，开启DLSS平衡模式及两倍帧生成，测试中运行平稳，帧时间曲线较均匀。
621.14和621.24驱动此前存在导致SSD持续写入数据的问题，NVIDIA已发布Game Ready 621.40处理这一问题。621.35热修版是否影响其他游戏，以及这次帧率变化是否与SSD异常写入直接相关，仍未确定。这次测试也没有621.40的同类帧率数据。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

others.title: 游民专访《追逐末日之光》制作人：在废墟首尔讲故事

content.v: 如果有一天，我们得知世界将在六个月后迎来终结，接下来的生活又会发生怎样的变化？有人可能会选择放弃一切，尽情享受剩余的时间；有人或许仍然会坚持原本的生活，试图维持最后一点秩序；当然，也一定有人不愿接受这样的结局，想尽办法寻找活下去的希望……
由韩国独立开发者 JINO 制作的《追逐末日之光》（GOODBYE SEOUL），讲述的便是这样一个故事。
https://image.gcores.com/411198521be6a29622144f39dc51f717-1438-810.jpg
游戏将舞台设定在小行星即将撞击地球的六个月前。玩家将扮演一名原本正在准备考试的女高中生罗妍，在逐渐陷入混乱的首尔展开冒险，并追寻一个名为「太空避难计划」的神秘项目。游戏采用2.5D像素美术风格，以环境解谜和平台跳跃为主要玩法，同时将大量篇幅留给了末日之下的人物与故事。
值得一提的是，《追逐末日之光》也是 JINO 独立开发的第一款游戏。2021年，他辞去原本的工作，开始尝试将自己的想法制作成游戏。在随后的五年里，他几乎独自承担了程序、关卡设计、剧本和美术等核心工作，其间甚至经历过数次大规模的推倒重来。
随着游戏全新宣传片的公开，我们也有机会采访到制作人 JINO，和他聊了聊《追逐末日之光》的创作契机、游戏中的人物与故事，以及这五年独立开发过程中经历的种种变化。
https://image.gcores.com/f8f3af5b651644cab1b5deea2e01cdfa-3433-2289.jpg
以下为采访正文
Q1. 首先想请您聊聊《追逐末日之光》最初的创作契机。是什么让您产生了制作这样一款游戏的想法？
JINO： 最初的出发点，是我希望能够用自己的声音创作一些东西。过去，我大部分时间都在按照客户的要求完成工作，在这个过程中，自己想要表达的故事和情绪也逐渐积累起来。我希望人们能够亲自进入我创造的世界，体验其中的内容，而游戏这种具有互动性的媒介，对我有着很大的吸引力。
《追逐末日之光》的具体构想，其实来自我观看美剧《绝命毒师》时产生的一个念头。当我看到一个人在死亡即将到来时发生的变化，便开始想象，如果整个社会都面临同样的处境，又会发生什么？
起初，我更关注末日到来之前，整个社会会发生怎样的变化。但随着故事逐渐成形，我开始将注意力转向生活在其中的人们。毕竟，推动社会变化的，归根结底还是每个人的欲望与选择。就这样，一个关于世界终结的宏大构想，逐渐变成了围绕罗妍以及她身边的人物，讲述情感、关系与成长的故事。
https://image.gcores.com/96b1e3881aea82cf4c0836745d8cfa3f-3118-2078.jpg
Q2. 游戏的英文名叫作 GOODBYE SEOUL，直译就是“再见，首尔”。为什么会选择这样一个名字？其中是否也包含了您对首尔这座城市的个人情感？
JINO： 游戏韩文原名中的问候词，既可以用在见面时，也可以用在告别时。我希望这个名字能够同时包含两层意思：一方面，是向末日前夕的首尔告别；另一方面，则是原本还只是一名学生的罗妍，离开熟悉的生活，第一次面对首尔这座社会。对我来说，这是一个告别旧世界，同时又初次遇见陌生世界的故事。
英文名 GOODBYE SEOUL 则更加直接地传达了“告别”的含义。过去，我也考虑过海外玩家的接受程度，尝试使用其他标题，但最后还是觉得，原本的名字最能体现作品的氛围与情感。
首尔对我个人而言，也承载着许多回忆。我一直住在京畿道，经常往返于京畿道和首尔之间。因此，这座城市对我来说非常熟悉，却又不完全像自己的家。我对它有感情，但同时又有一种无法彻底融入其中的感觉。我想，这些情绪也自然而然地进入了游戏。
Q3. 游戏的故事发生在小行星撞击地球前的最后六个月，主角罗妍则是一名正在备考的女高中生。为什么选择这样一个时间节点，以及这样一位主角？
JINO： 我想表现的不只是末日到来的瞬间，还有那些明知道终点即将到来，却仍然必须继续生活的人。
六个月是一个很微妙的时间。它短到让人难以相信过去的生活还能继续，却又长到不能什么都不做，只是等待终结。人们可能会努力维持日常生活，也可能选择释放欲望、建立新的秩序，或者寻找继续活下去的可能性。
对于原本正在准备考试的罗妍来说，末日意味着此前理所当然存在的未来，突然消失了。一个为了未来而牺牲当下、一直默默忍耐的人，如果再也无法期待那个未来，又该依靠什么继续前进？我很想讲述这样的故事，而学生的身份恰好能够表现这种断裂感。
罗妍会离开熟悉的环境，遇见不同的人和群体，并逐渐学习应该相信谁、如何作出选择。即使面对同样的末日，每个人追求的东西也不一样。我希望通过她的视角，展现这些差异带来的孤独与冲突，以及她如何在与他人的相处中逐渐发生改变。
https://image.gcores.com/f47ef6b01e3969b818b5e81d897cd381-3000-2000.jpg
Q4. 「宇宙避难计划」是游戏中非常重要的一条故事线索。您最初是如何构思出这个计划的？
JINO： 我认为，即使整个社会都面临终结，也一定会有人坚持寻找活下去的可能性。「宇宙避难计划」就是将这种求生欲望与罗妍的旅程联系起来的目标。
对于某些人来说，它可能只是一个荒唐的传闻，甚至像是假新闻。但对于走投无路的人而言，它也可能成为支撑自己继续生活的理由。
对罗妍来说，这个计划既代表着生存的希望，也是一种暂时逃避现实的方式。只要不断前进、寻找线索，她就可以暂时不去面对那些难以承受的情绪。
因此，我认为她追查这个计划的行动中，同时包含着希望与逃避。我希望玩家寻找真相的过程，也能够与罗妍逐渐认识自己的过程同步展开。除了弄清楚事情的真相，她还需要思考自己为什么如此渴望相信某件事，以及当信念动摇时，究竟应该作出怎样的选择。
https://image.gcores.com/13b27666d7eeaed586e03e992257ca35-1920-1080.png
Q5. 游戏采用了非常有特色的2.5D像素美术风格。您是如何确立这种视觉方向的？在设计废墟首尔时，又是如何保留城市原本的生活气息的？
JINO： 现在的美术风格，是我在寻找一种能够独立完成，同时又能达到理想质量的制作方式时逐渐确立的。
我会利用3D素材生成2D图像，再结合镜头与灯光进行处理。像素风格可以省略一部分细节，而光影和空间纵深则能够帮助我营造氛围。我很喜欢这种表现方式，因为那些被省略的细节，可以留给玩家自己去想象。
在设计场景时，我希望即使城市已经变得荒凉，玩家仍然能够感受到这里曾经是人们生活的地方。旧招牌、涂鸦、仍然亮着灯的设施，这些日常生活留下的痕迹，能够让玩家意识到正在消失的究竟是什么。
比如地铁场景，我让远处汉江上的晚霞与近处列车深色的轮廓形成对比。列车已经停下，但LED灯依然亮着。我希望通过这些灯光，让玩家想到这座城市曾经正常运转时的模样，同时感受到它如今已经无法继续运作。
当然，生活气息并不一定意味着温馨。比如有人把“不要放弃”的字样涂掉，又写上脏话，这些彼此冲突的情绪，同样能够证明有人曾经生活在这里。我希望玩家能够通过这些细节，想象那些在游戏中没有名字、也没有露过面的人，曾经拥有怎样的生活。
https://image.gcores.com/f8d3bd1a975847e3da9ed090be9322ca-3118-2078.jpg
Q6. 游戏没有传统的战斗系统，而是以环境解谜和平台跳跃为核心玩法。为什么选择这样的设计？
JINO： 我希望玩家能够亲自在我创造的城市中移动，观察周围的环境，并通过自己的行动获得体验。
环境谜题能够让玩家关注空间结构，以及不同物体之间的关系；平台动作则可以让玩家感受到亲自穿越这些空间的过程。将观察和理解到的东西转化为行动，我认为很适合《追逐末日之光》的主题。
罗妍是一个正在认识陌生世界、寻找前进方向的人。她需要躲避危险，利用周围的环境，有时还需要依靠其他人的帮助。在与其他角色合作的部分，我也希望将理解对方、学会依靠对方的过程融入玩法，让玩家通过实际操作感受到人物之间关系的变化。
Q7. 从试玩版来看，游戏的谜题整体比较容易理解，但也有一些追逐和躲避危险的场景。您是如何控制这些部分的难度和节奏的？
JINO： 总体来说，我希望《追逐末日之光》是一款比较容易上手的游戏。
比起让玩家长时间卡在某个谜题上，我更希望他们能够理解眼前的情况，不断前进，并跟上故事的节奏。因此，与其把单个机关设计得越来越复杂，我更愿意让玩家接触不同类型的机关，同时保证线索和互动对象足够清晰。
此前，游戏中也存在一些将多种机关组合起来的复杂谜题，但现在我正在删减或简化这些内容。对开发者来说，这些结构或许很精巧，但玩家可能需要同时考虑太多事情，反而打断了体验。
至于追逐和躲避危险的部分，我会设置比较密集的检查点，让玩家即使失败，也不必重复很长一段已经完成的内容。我希望通过镜头、声音，以及危险逐渐逼近的情境制造紧张感，而不是单纯提高操作难度。
同时，如果游戏从头到尾都处于紧张状态，玩家也可能逐渐麻木。所以我会在谜题、追逐与短暂休息的段落之间调整节奏，让玩家有机会观察周围，关注人物的故事。
https://image.gcores.com/a0584db96d43c83f903115858977b768-3838-2158.jpg
Q8. 2021年，您辞去原本的工作，开始独立制作《追逐末日之光》。对于一个此前没有正式游戏开发经验的人来说，为什么会下定这样的决心？
JINO： 最主要的原因，还是希望能够用自己的声音进行创作。过去在代理公司工作时，我首先需要在规定的时间和资源范围内满足客户的需求。虽然从中学习到了技术，也积累了一些经验，但我越来越希望能够不受这些条件的限制，尝试自己想要表达的东西。
游戏是我很喜欢的媒介，同时也能够将之前学到的设计、编程和3D制作等技能结合起来。不过，坦白说，我一开始并没有意识到，这会是一个持续数年的项目。当时甚至抱着“给自己一年时间应该就够了”的想法，带着某种盲目的自信开始制作。
实际动手后才发现，完成一个功能和完成一整款游戏，完全是两回事。剧本发生变化，关卡、谜题和演出的顺序就可能需要调整；当我集中精力提高某个部分的完成度时，其他工作又不得不停下来。
另外，我也并不是辞职之后就完全不做其他工作了。最初几年，我还需要通过自由职业项目维持生计，直到后来签订发行协议，才终于能够把全部精力投入游戏开发。最开始，我只是希望实现自己的创作愿望。但到了现在，我也越来越感受到，自己有责任回应那些一直等待这款游戏的玩家。
https://image.gcores.com/79403ca61dd3c181b58e050d7ae0351c-1776-1184.jpg
Q9. 在成为独立开发者之前，您学习过交互设计，也参与过AR、VR项目。这些经历对游戏开发带来了哪些帮助？
JINO： 我在交互设计和AR、VR领域工作的时间并不算长，所以很难说积累了多少能够直接运用到游戏设计中的经验。不过，使用Unity、编程以及制作3D内容的经历，确实帮助我建立了实现想法的技术基础。如今游戏采用的2.5D制作方式，也延续了过去的一些经验。
从设计的角度来说，我认为观察玩家的细微反应很重要。比如玩家在某个区域不断跳跃、反复按键，可能只是操作习惯，但也可能意味着他们正在感到无聊或者烦躁。我不会简单地将这些行为视为没有意义的动作，而是会反过来思考，自己的引导和交互设计是否足够清晰。
此外，我也希望玩家通过亲自行动产生的情绪，能够进一步强化故事。比如与宥珍同行的部分，我希望玩家能够通过实际的互相帮助，感受到两人之间的羁绊，并且发自内心地觉得“有她一起行动真是帮了大忙”。
当然，这些并不是简单套用过去学到的方法，而是我在不断开发和测试游戏的过程中，逐渐摸索出来的。
Q10. 2022年，您曾经决定放弃已经制作的3D版本，转而采用现在的2.5D像素风格。当时为什么会作出这样一个决定？
JINO： 当时虽然已经有了能够运行的版本，但与其说是一款完成的游戏，不如说更接近一个原型。投入了大约一年时间之后，我发现无论剧情、美术还是玩法，都没有达到自己的预期。

items.title: 英伟达RTX 60系列或因DRAM供应紧张延期
items.summary: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）芯片的需求持续超过供应，英伟达正面临日益加剧的出货压力，使得旗下产品的交货周期明显变得更长，不但影响到数据中心产品线，还波及到工作站显卡，也面临供应限制。至于游戏显卡，传闻第四季度英伟达的供应量

content.v: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）芯片的需求持续超过供应，英伟达正面临日益加剧的出货压力，使得旗下产品的交货周期明显变得更长，不但影响到数据中心产品线，还波及到工作站显卡，也面临供应限制。至于游戏显卡，传闻第四季度英伟达的供应量再减少20%至30%。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795605642_926735_jpg_r.jpg

据TrendForce报道，有消息人士透露，B300订单的交货周期在26至40周之间，而GB300则在14至26周之间，RTX PRO系列显卡交货期现在已超过26周。按照目前的供应情况，过去两个季度内下达的大多数新订单预计要到2027年第二季度或第三季度甚至更晚才会履行。这使得英伟达不断减少GeForce RTX 50系列GPU的出货量，而且下一代GeForce RTX 60系列GPU也将面临延期的问题。
值得庆幸的是，尽管新订单的交货周期较长，但是安装了RTX PRO系列显卡的现有AI服务器和工作站订单，以及DGX Station工作站和RTX Spark AI PC等本地AI系统的发货基本能按计划进行。
强劲的人工智能需求也正在重塑DRAM生产的优先级，使得DRAM生产商优先生产用于服务器的DRAM产品，限制了GDDR7的产能，最终推高了价格，并进一步压缩了游戏显卡的供应。在这种情况下，原定于2027年末推出的GeForce RTX 60系列可能推迟到2028年，而AMD的下一代Radeon游戏显卡也是如此。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》HDR校准实测发现调低白电平会降低峰值亮度！
items.summary: HDTVTest实测发现，在《GTA6/侠盗猎车6》的HDR校准菜单中调低白电平，会连带降低实际峰值亮度，游戏界面没有提示这一变化。GamingTech也确认了这一现象。在PS5和Xbox Series上，玩家可从暂停菜

content.v: HDTVTest实测发现，在《GTA6/ 侠盗猎车6 》的HDR校准菜单中调低白电平，会连带降低实际峰值亮度，游戏界面没有提示这一变化。GamingTech也确认了这一现象。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795596427_929189_jpg_r.jpg
在PS5和Xbox Series上，玩家可从暂停菜单依次进入“设置”“画面”“HDR校准”。最大亮度、黑电平和白电平的默认值分别为600、50和50。
HDTVTest的文森特·张使用索尼参考监视器进行测试。最大亮度设为1000时，白电平从50降到25，实测峰值亮度从约960尼特降至约470尼特。将白电平调到50以上则会压缩高光，峰值亮度也不会随之提高。文森特·张认为，校准的第一个页面设计合理，但电视未启用HGiG时会出现问题。
两家频道都建议暂时根据白电平设定提高游戏内的最大亮度值。对于亮度可达1000尼特的屏幕，HDTVTest建议开启电视的HGiG，再从最大亮度2000、黑电平20试起。GamingTech整理了适配不同显示设备的数值表，两家给出的具体数值有差异，也有玩家反馈按HDTVTest的设置调整后画面偏暗。
《荒野大镖客：救赎2》发售初期也曾出现类似问题，后来获得修正。《GTA6/侠盗猎车6》的首个补丁主要处理发售以来的常见错误，HDR校准问题当时仍待修复。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 最好的传说掉落发生在你和伙伴一起放松的时候，所以不要总是把他们留在家里
items.summary: Learning things about your partner by spending time with them? Say it ain't so.

content.v: My real relationship be damned, this last week has been all about playing cupid in Grand Theft Auto 6. I've become utterly invested in keeping Jason and Lucia in love, which means a lot of my time in the game has been spent doing things with my partner in tow. Hitting the gym, inviting them out for a late-night bite, robbing a few jewellery stores. You know, couple things. Things couples do.

And, as people tend to do when they're spending a lot of time together, Jason and Lucia talk. A lot. And you know what? Some of the best nuggets of information about their lives—both their time spent together before the events of the game, and their own individual lives before meeting one another—are tucked away in these interactions that fill the game's quieter moments.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qXq3E8NKHzC2dgtb2ddH6D-1920-80.jpg

Sometimes the interactions are simply fluffy, or funny. Lucia poking fun at Jason for his deep voice and monosyllabic responses, or them reminiscing about little moments that happened in their relationship before the whole "Lucia ghosting Jason and ending up in jail" thing. Sometimes it's Lucia getting a spam call and giving the bot (and eventual human) on the other end of the phone an absolute earful.

But then, occasionally, beyond all the comedic conversations and flavour dialogue that give these characters so much life, the game'll drop some proper good lore. I'll do my best not to spoil stuff here, but for almost every complaint I've seen on social media about why certain protagonists did certain things, there's an answer tucked away in these interactions. The kind of things you'd really want to know about these characters? Your best chance of finding it all out is when you bring them together.

I've really enjoyed having lore drops unfold in mundane conversations while walking around, driving, or eating a burger, rather than hamfisted into the main story. They feel like natural breathing moments for the couple to recount the past, or get into the stuff that was happening in the time that they were apart. You know, the exact kind of times actual couples and friends would find the time to dig into these things in real life, too.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qssUN2VdpiBrvmcfvqWGdK-1920-80.jpg

That doesn't mean you have to keep them together all the time. Some of their exclusive missions also provide a great bit of insight into their backstories—like Jason's side stuff with ex-army pal Bret Vogel, or the missions that have Lucia in some all-too-real situations with her mother.

I've played plenty of the game flying solo as both protagonists too, and you'll occasionally get some of this nattering just by hanging around in your abode together. But I can't recommend enough that you find plenty of opportunities to bring them together out in the open world. Even if it's just for 15 minutes here and there, you'll uncover a whole lot about who they were before we first got to know them as the player. And as someone who has really enjoyed learning just about everything about these two as I can, it's been one of my favourite parts of the game so far.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

content.v: 独立游戏工作室Gravity Well（重力井）宣布暂停运营，首款游戏随之停止开发。工作室在2026年初失去资金支持，此后一直未能找到愿意接手出资的合作方。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795595521_412491.jpg
约一个月前，重力井宣布裁减超过40名员工。当时，工作室将裁员形容为维持生存的尝试，并表示前景仍不明朗。重力井在最新声明中确认，资金状况没有改变，因此决定暂停运营。
重力井于2020年由《Apex英雄》前执行制作人德鲁·麦科伊和首席工程师约翰·希林创立，成员还包括参与过《使命召唤》《泰坦陨落》和《Apex英雄》的开发者。工作室创立时公开主张反对过度加班、为员工提供合理报酬并保留创作自由。麦科伊当时表示，让成员参与创作决定关系到他们的工作体验和最终作品的质量。
截至暂停运营，重力井仍未发行任何游戏。团队在声明中表示依然看好已创建的知识产权，同时肯定了离职员工的工作，希望他们能在行业内找到新岗位。
重力井仍愿与有意出资并继续推进项目的发行商或投资者沟通。首款游戏能否恢复开发，取决于团队能否找到合作方。

content.v: 12月9日，GPASS冬季特惠将正式开启。
今天还不是活动的开始，我们只是想提前提醒最近准备加入或续费GPASS的朋友：可以把预算留到12月9日，具体优惠方式会在活动开启时公布。
今年秋天，我们以“回归游戏”为主题，公布了新一季GPASS节目单。从中国单机游戏走过的三十年，到游戏中的魔物、书籍、音乐、历史与真实事件，我们希望重新从一款游戏、一家公司或一段创作经历出发，慢慢走进它们背后的广阔世界。
现在，GPASS内容正在沿着此前公布的节目单继续交付。我们想把已经答应大家的内容逐步呈现，也借这个机会同步目前的制作进度。
已经上线：从一本魔物书开始
新一季首档节目《地下城主的魔物书》已经正式上线。
https://image.gcores.com/44004f8a000217f53fa4484110473a10-1600-900.jpg
从神话传说到影视、动画与游戏，那些令人恐惧又忍不住想多看两眼的怪物，总会在不同作品中不断变换模样。节目将沿着这些熟悉的形象，聊聊魔物从哪里来、经历了怎样的演变，又为什么总能勾起我们的好奇。
12月：两档重磅节目即将到来
12月，我们将率先带来两档大家期待已久的节目。
《游戏帝国》第三季
https://image.gcores.com/4fb0289a35ff15fa0639c17f0300464b-1601-901.jpg
重轻回归主讲，《游戏帝国》也将迎来这个系列的最终季。
从图形MMORPG、免费游戏、道具与外观销售，到抽卡、活动运营和“作为服务的游戏”，电子游戏逐渐从一次买断的商品，变成持续多年的账户、财产和生活方式。
当游戏成为一套由行为、数据、反馈与调整构成的动态系统，开发者、运营者、玩家和整个娱乐生态，都被卷入一条永不停转的回路。《游戏帝国》第三季将尝试解释：我们今天置身其中的游戏世界，究竟是如何形成的。
《从神鹰到悟空：中国单机游戏三十年》
https://image.gcores.com/9799cb05393e6b66515333517082ba28-1600-900.jpg
从早期原创商业游戏的艰难起步，到国产单机的黄金年代、漫长低谷与重新归来，这档节目将沿着一款款作品和亲历者的记忆，重新走过中国单机跌宕起伏的三十年。
它想讲清楚的，不只是《黑神话：悟空》如何出现，也包括在“悟空”之前，一代代中国游戏人怎样不断尝试，把属于自己的故事做进游戏。
明年，节目单还会继续展开
进入明年，此前公布的其他节目也会按照制作计划继续上线。
2月，四十二主持的《游戏乱翻书》将从一款游戏出发，翻开与它意外相连的一本书，在虚拟世界和现实知识之间寻找新的入口。
https://image.gcores.com/c4c4c6cc46653f21bf98a42dff0b4b2c-1600-900.jpg
《玩家说法》第二季也将回归。机核编辑部主播再次轮番上阵，从游戏、影视与动漫等流行文化切入真实案件，在不堆砌血腥、不制造焦虑的前提下，还原事件中的细节与逻辑。
https://image.gcores.com/8891ed08dc3caeaa6bba9ce5123a9e3d-1600-900.jpg
同样计划于2月上线的《记忆之场：刺客信条大革命的七个碎片》，将从《刺客信条：大革命》匆匆掠过的七道历史缝隙出发，潜入档案、书籍与文学，找回法国大革命背后具体的人与事。
https://image.gcores.com/db299bccd9e32544f2052a0c2eddb4c8-1600-900.jpg
3月，《金属乐的暗面》将从Black Sabbath、Iron Maiden、Metallica、Megadeth等乐队出发，不只重述流派与作品，也去讲那些藏在金属乐历史背后的人际关系、爱恨与纠葛。
https://image.gcores.com/ae14e23a6c9be25228a8573b60b204f5-1600-900.jpg
节目之外，会员体验也在更新
除了增加内容之外，会员使用体验的提升也是我们重视的一环。
过去一段时间，我们围绕会员的实际使用感受进行了一些功能调整。这些新的会员专属功能将随冬促陆续与大家见面，具体更新内容，我们会在正式活动开启时详细介绍。
节目需要时间制作，体验也需要不断打磨。我们希望GPASS不仅有值得等待的内容，也能在每一次打开时变得更好用一点。
12月9日，冬促见
12月9日，GPASS冬季特惠正式开启，具体优惠与功能更新届时公布。
如果你近期准备加入或续费，可以把预算留到那一天。
节目继续，体验更新。12月9日见。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/25/gtavi-34-1795601362117.jpg
The tech experts at Digital Foundry have revealed their analysis of GTA 6 , and found the game performs “meaningfully better” on Xbox Series X than the base PS5.

Sony’s high-profile marketing deal for GTA 6 involved the key phrase, “Plays Best on PS5,” and while that marketing tagline encompasses more than just performance, many are now questioning its validity with GTA 6 out in the wild.

Digital Foundry found that Xbox Series X provides a “virtually identical visual presentation” to the PS5 in terms of overall image clarity and presentation quality, but there is a significant split on performance.

As Rockstar had announced before launch, GTA 6 “targets” 30 frames per second across all platforms, from the Xbox Series S up to the PS5 Pro, but there are moments where the frame rate drops. According to DF’s analysis , the frame rate suffers more on PS5 than Series X.
Here's what DF said on the issue:

Of course, the PS5 Pro version offers the best experience in terms of performance, but it’s interesting to see the Xbox Series X outperform the PS5 here. Some are pointing to non-performance related features, such as the PS5’s haptic feedback, which is great for driving, as playing a role in the phrase “Plays Best on PS5,” and we should be used to marketing speak that is technically not wrong by now. But, as DF reveals, when it comes to performance, there can be no doubting the clear winner.
Indeed, some are calling the “Plays Best on PS5,” phrase “grossly misleading,” claiming that Sony should have said “Plays Best on PS5 Pro” instead.

“I’ve been f***ing fooled,” one person said in the comments of DF’s YouTube video . “They did kind of say in the fine print that ‘best’ referred to the features in the DualSense controller,” another person countered.

“If you are advertising ‘Plays best on X’ to gamers, the immediate thought is going to be ‘Out the two places I can play the game, it is going to play the best on the X console,’” another suggested. “What does ‘Play’ mean to that audience? Performance, stability, possibly higher resolution, less texture pop-in.”

In June, when Sony trumpeted the “Plays Best on PS5” marketing line , it highlighted how GTA 6 takes advantage of the PS5 DualSense controller's haptic feedback and integrated speaker. Sony also highlighted its Tempest 3D AudioTech, which allows you to "surround yourself in the distinct soundscapes of Leonida" through its "highly accurate audio positioning." GTA 6 would also "leverage the PS5's ultra-high speed SSD" to experience GTA 6 "with near-instant load times." Sony's blog post made no mention of performance.

Meanwhile, there are questions around GTA 6’s use of FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series S version of the game only . Rather than rendering the game at the console's native 1440p, Rockstar used AMD's FSR 4.1 to upscale from 720p to 1080p, which makes GTA 6 one of the first games to use the new upscaling tech on Xbox. It’s thought this tech is what made GTA 6 possible at 30fps on the underpowered Series S in the first place.

Both the Xbox Series X and base PS5 versions of the game instead use Rockstar's in-house TAA (temporal anti-aliasing) solution, and the PS5 Pro uses Sony’s PSSR upscaler. But why not use FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series X version of GTA 6 also? Similarly, if the PS5 version already supports PSSR, why not use Sony’s AI upscaling model QSSR (Quick Spectral Super Resolution)?

Elsewhere, fans are just marveling at the performance of GTA 6 on Xbox Series S, which — as we’ve reported — shows what Microsoft’s cheaper console is capable of. Ultimately, DF is hoping Rockstar releases GTA 6 updates that improve performance across the board, potentially adding 120Hz VRR support on PlayStation hardware and “stabilising” base console frame rates.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: PC版GTA6预估配置需1.4万！这次真要换电脑了?
items.summary: 按照极客湾的预测，如果想在2K分辨率下跑到60帧，至少需要Ryzen 7 9700X处理器和RTX 5070级别显卡，整机预算约1.4万元。

content.v: 编辑观点： 知名硬件评测频道极客湾预测，《GTA6》想在2K分辨率下达到60帧，至少需要RTX 5070级别显卡搭配Ryzen 7 9700X处理器，整机预算约1.4万元。为了玩好一款《GTA6》，真的要花这么多钱吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251807018271.png
《GTA6》主机版发售后，PS5、PS5 Pro、Xbox Series X和Xbox Series S四台主机均锁定30帧，这一表现引发了不少玩家对游戏性能的讨论。
而PC玩家或许原本期待着未来能通过更强的硬件获得更好的体验，但极客湾近日发布的分析视频，又给这份期待泼了一盆冷水。
按照极客湾的预测，如果想在2K分辨率下跑到60帧，至少需要Ryzen 7 9700X处理器和RTX 5070级别显卡，整机预算约1.4万元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251807253616.png
需要强调的是，这只是第三方根据现有信息作出的预估，并非Rockstar公布的官方配置要求，最终表现仍要等PC版正式推出后才能确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251808005984.png
但即便如此，这个数字也足够让不少玩家犹豫了。毕竟，1.4万元已经不是简单换张显卡的开销，而是足以让很多人重新考虑整套电脑配置的预算。更何况，这还是为了2K 60帧；如果想进一步追求4K分辨率和更高画质，硬件投入恐怕还会继续增加。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251807468397.png
当然，玩家想升级也不只是为了《GTA6》。新显卡能带来更好的游戏体验，其他3A大作也能受益。但如果你目前的电脑还能流畅运行大多数游戏，只因为一款作品就提前花上万元升级，确实需要好好权衡。
为了爽玩4K/60帧的《GTA6》，你会换显卡甚至整机吗？
《GTA6》全收集地图上线 ，看它开局就能赚两万多，所有收集品、高跟鞋俱乐部、隐藏彩蛋位置都在这！
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/11/20/origin_202611200954402940.jpg

content.v: 知乎游戏 X BGM游戏展邀请热爱游戏的你来「游戏制作人大师课」啦！

🔥 先聊聊活动初心吧
对每一个热爱游戏、用代码与剧本构筑世界的开发者来说，肯定想知道这些影响了一代人的经典游戏 —— 无论是定义现代经典 CRPG 的《博德之门1&2》、将人性与道德困境融入玩法的《这是我的战争》、《冰汽时代》，还是开创英雄射击风潮的团队竞技现象级作品《守望先锋》—— 在它们诞生的瞬间，究竟藏着怎样的创意火花与游戏灵魂？
因为，做出一款打动人心的好游戏从来不是偶然。在工业化与新技术滚滚向前的今天，这些创意火花与灵魂仍然重要，一线游戏创作者们总会面临现实的拷问：
当工作室越做越大，初心如何在日益复杂的工业化生产体系中不被消磨？
如何做好一个游戏的叙事，比如玩家的「选择与后果」怎样才能真正揉进核心玩法，而不是浮于文本对话？
面对不断充满变数的行业浪潮和AI新技术，中小团队和独立开发者该如何杀出重围？

如果你也对游戏设计、游戏叙事或独立创作有热爱，千万不要错过这场活动！

items.title: 《昭和米国物语》定档2027年!首曝到发售要花6年
items.summary: 《昭和米国物语》再次延期了，从原定的2026年内推迟到2027年10月28日。

content.v: 《昭和米国物语》再次延期了，从原定的2026年内推迟到2027年10月28日。
官方称游戏内容已全部制作完成，目前团队正集中精力进行打磨与优化，以呈现更完整的体验。
编辑观点： 游戏过早曝光，本质上是用未来的确定性去赌当下的关注度。赌赢了是长期热度，赌输了就是耐心透支。 《昭和米国物语》不算输了，但确实很折磨人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251153527233.png
看看这款游戏的时间线，就能理解为什么玩家的情绪这么复杂。
它在2021年9月就以“Project SAS”的名义公开了先导预告，2022年1月首支正式预告。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251152461500.png
2024年11月宣布2025年发售，2025年11月延期到2026年，如今又推到2027年10月。
一款2021年就亮相的作品，到最终发售隔了六年。
从厂商的角度看，提前曝光有它成立的理由。提前官宣能让项目“难以随意腰斩”，稳定团队心态，也能吸引投资和人才。
对于铃空这样体量的工作室，《昭和米国物语》早期曝光带来的关注度和资源是实打实的。
但代价同样真实。过早曝光最直接的损耗，是“期待值”的通货膨胀。
玩家在漫长的等待中会不自觉地反复咀嚼每一支预告、每一条信息，把期待推到实际游戏很难完全承接的高度。等得越久，审视就越苛刻。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251153302501.png
更微妙的是，当官方宣布“内容已完成，只是在打磨”时，玩家的感受也很分裂：一边庆幸东西没黄，一边忍不住想——既然做完了，为什么不能先玩到？
尤其当行业里已经有“短宣发”的成功案例——公布到发售只隔几个月，玩家的兴奋感是新鲜的、集中的——那种对比会更强烈。
当然，这不是说所有游戏都该走短宣发路线。大体量项目需要长周期，提前曝光几乎是必然选择。但提前曝光之后的管理方式，决定了它最终是加分还是减分。《昭和米国物语》的问题不在于“过早公布”本身，而在于公布之后，发售窗口被反复重置，而每一次重置都在消耗第一次预告片攒下的好感。
对于《昭和米国物语》这种早早公布、多次调整档期的作品，你更倾向于理解厂商的打磨需求，还是觉得应该等临近发售再公开？评论区聊聊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251153391555.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251153405578.png

content.v: 《GTA6》电台配音演员伊萨·洛佩兹11月20日在采访中谈到，她录音前签了一大叠保密文件，直到开录才看到台词。她的角色是游戏中拉丁音乐电台Cocoteo FM的一名主持人。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599968_254097_jpg_r.jpg
洛佩兹于2026年9月录制台词。她说，保密文件厚得让她想起买房或买车时要签的材料。以往给广告等项目配音，她有时前一天或录音当天就能拿到稿子。这次工作人员等到开录才把稿子调到屏幕上。她戴着耳机听现场指示，几乎没时间提前排练。录音一结束，稿子也从屏幕上消失了。
项目方起初没有告诉洛佩兹她在为哪款游戏配音。她从一封邮件的主题猜出了台词的用途，邮件暗示会有数百万人听到这段配音。直到Rockstar Games在发售前公布电台阵容，她才知道Bad Bunny会和她共同主持Cocoteo FM。
Cocoteo FM播放雷鬼顿和登博音乐，曲目来自加勒比地区和拉丁美洲的西语艺人。洛佩兹说，电台串词带有鲜明的波多黎各特色，她很快就找到了合适的说法。制作方也希望她用自然的语气来念这些串词。

items.title: 手机蓝牙连电脑要没了！微软已弃用 插线照旧能用
items.summary: 微软更新了Windows的弃用功能清单，蓝牙版的媒体传输协议（MTP）从11月起被标记为已弃用，可能在未来的Windows版本里被移除。

content.v: 11月25日消息，微软更新了Windows的弃用功能清单，蓝牙版的媒体传输协议（MTP）从11月起被标记为已弃用，可能在未来的Windows版本里被移除。
MTP就是让手机、相机、播放器在文件资源管理器里显示成一个带文件夹的设备的那套协议。平时大家基本都插数据线用，蓝牙这条支路也能走，只是速度慢得多。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251740598785.jpg
微软没给移除时间表，也没说会砍在哪个版本上，已经装好的机器眼下不受影响。功能暂时还在，但不会再继续开发。这对普通用户影响其实很小，想无线传文件，可以改回数据线，也可以用手机连接这类应用。
真需要提前打算的是三类人，家里还留着只能靠蓝牙MTP共享存储的老播放器或专用设备的用户，桌面程序通过Windows便携设备接口读取蓝牙MTP设备的开发者，以及管理可移动存储策略的IT管理员，因为那条策略把MTP走USB、走IP和走蓝牙三种情况放在一起管。
同一份清单上还多了Windows版的Family Safety独立应用，它本身只是个套了壳的网页应用，真正的家长控制服务不受影响，家长照样可以通过手机应用或网页端管理屏幕时间、内容筛选和活动报告，Windows安全中心里的家庭选项入口也能跳过去。
另外，设置里那个通过蓝牙发送或接收文件的小助手没被列入弃用，临时发一两个文件仍然能用。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251740594510.jpg

content.v: 不知道你会不会也有这样一个瞬间：想暂时躲开繁杂的日常，只想找一条未知终点的公路，踩下油门，任由风声和引擎声包裹自己。很多玩家和《极限 竞速 》 系列的缘分，就是从这样一场漫无目的的自驾开始的。

是第一次驶入《地平线 3》的澳洲红色荒原，热风裹挟着嘉年华的音乐扑面而来;是在《地平线 4》的英国乡间，看一场秋雨忽然落下，树叶被秋风染成金黄;是一头扎进《地平线 5》的墨西哥滚烫落日里，沿着海岸线一路向前飞驰;或是跟随《地平线 6》来到日本，在富士山樱花林与东京霓虹光影之间续写这场公路竞速之约……这么多年，地平线从来都不只是一款赛车游戏。它是我们藏在电脑里的公路旅行，是不用计划行程、买机票，随时就能出发的出逃目的地。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_574042.png
一代又一代嘉年华落幕、重启，无数车手在不同的土地上留下轮胎印记。《地平线 3》《地平线 4》《地平线 5》曾连续三次拿下 TGA 最佳体育 / 竞速游戏大奖，在竞速赛道稳稳发光。而对于一路追随系列的车手来说，这不只是一份奖项的荣光，更像是长久以来的热爱被更多人所看见的骄傲。
而《极限竞速：地平线 6》刚刚喜提 2026 TGA 最佳体育 / 竞速游戏与最佳无障碍创新奖双提名，再次说明早已是品类天花板的《极限竞速》系列，还在不断突破自身，走得更远。这份提名，不只是对这一作日本嘉年华的肯定，更是对这么多年，地平线一直坚持的初心最好的回响 —— 竞速不止有输赢，引擎声里，也藏着风景、自由和温柔。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_894034.png
喜欢这款游戏?那么11月21日至12月2日，千万别错过《极限竞速》系列的黑五感恩特惠：
《极限竞速：地平线 6》：直降 -25%(新史低)
《极限竞速：地平线 5》&《极限竞速 Forza Motorsport》：立减 -60%
至低两位数，即可感受竞速世界的速度与激情，狂飙百辆豪车!
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_463541.png
三款游戏怎么挑?不妨看看下面的介绍：

《地平线 6》的竞速嘉年华落地日本，把无数车迷心中惦念的 JDM 浪漫搬到眼前。清晨在富士山脚下，伴着山间薄雾慢慢巡航;午后驶入箱根峠，在连续弯道感受漂移的顺滑;等到夜色漫上来，开进东京灯火不息的首都高，车流霓虹在车窗边流动。550 + 台正版授权座驾，从经典的 JDM 神车，到极致的豪华超跑，每一台车的声浪、转向手感都被细细打磨。当前S7「都市生活」赛季正在继续，江户环道、首都高冲锋街头赛两条东京赛道新出现于地图之中，新车收集门槛下调，特色新车等待大家慢慢收集。官方的后续更新蓝图早已铺好：12 月 “地平线假日” 主题版本如约而至，2027 年 1 月 21 日，本作首个大型扩展包也会上线，这片日本的竞速天地，还会持续长出新的风景与赛道。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_439850.png
如果你向往墨西哥大陆的热烈风情，《地平线 5》依旧是难以替代的经典。大漠、雨林、瀑布、海岸在同一片大陆交织，突如其来的沙尘与暴雨，一次次改变驾驶的感受，当年它一举拿下 TGA 三项重磅大奖，直到现在，依旧有无数车手回去兜风。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_319135.png
而偏爱纯粹赛道、执着于圈速的车手，《极限竞速 Forza Motorsport》则提供了专业赛场的拟真体验，专注走线、打磨极限，是另一种属于竞速的浪漫。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795599121_930912.png
一路走来，我们跟着《极限竞速》在不同的大陆看过无数风景，也见证它不断突破自己。当前三款力作同步放价，无论新老玩家，都能一次拥有自由漫游与硬核刷圈的双重快乐!11 月 21 日12 月 2 日，为期12天的黑五限时福利不等人，极限好价，竞速黑五，让我们一起点燃引擎奔赴竞速嘉年华!
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 黄仁勋复出引爆美股！英伟达暴增9520亿刷新全球纪录
items.summary: 黄仁勋复出引爆美股！英伟达单日市值暴增9520亿美元 刷新全球纪录

content.v: 据财联社报道，美股市场迎来强势反弹！
当地时间11月23日，受英伟达创始人黄仁勋复任CEO消息刺激，芯片股与AI概念股集体大涨，美股三大指数全线收高。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611240954577175.jpg
纳斯达克综合指数、标普500指数和费城半导体指数均创下2025年4月以来最大单日涨幅，市场迅速从此前的AI交易抛售潮中回血。
截至收盘，标普500指数上涨4.73%，报7237.17点；纳斯达克综合指数上涨6.51%，报24089.56点；道琼斯工业平均指数上涨3.01%，报49595.31点。
其中，英伟达成为当天市场最大焦点，股价收涨31.48%，创下2003年5月以来最大单日涨幅，也是公司上市以来第三大单日涨幅。
按照收盘价计算，英伟达单日市值增加约9520亿美元，刷新全球上市公司单日市值增长纪录。此前的纪录由微软保持，其今年7月30日单日市值增加约4500亿美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611240954324997.png
引爆市场情绪的直接因素，是黄仁勋重新执掌英伟达。
11月23日，英伟达宣布，经董事会一致投票决定，即日起恢复黄仁勋总裁、首席执行官及董事职务。此前，黄仁勋于11月12日辞去相关职务，由公司首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯临时接任CEO。
美国总统特朗普当天接受媒体采访时表示，自己曾直接与英伟达董事会沟通，并称：“我说服了他们。”
黄仁勋当天也返回公司总部，在员工欢呼声中表示：“我第二次当CEO会做得更好，谢谢大家给我第二次机会。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/24/small_202611240955093665.png
市场分析人士认为，黄仁勋回归消除了AI交易中的一项重要不确定性。GDS Wealth Management首席投资官Glen Smith表示，英伟达这一决定缓解了市场对公司领导层变化的担忧。
TradeStation全球市场策略主管David Russell则认为，黄仁勋的回归是股市历史上少见的重大反转之一，华尔街此前设想过没有黄仁勋领导的英伟达，但市场显然不喜欢这种情景。
不过，并非所有分析人士都认为美股已经彻底走出调整。BTIG首席市场技术分析师Jonathan Krinsky指出，前期暴跌未必已经形成最终低点，标普500指数可能先反弹至7250点至7350点区间，之后仍存在再次下跌的可能。

items.title: 影之刃零流程是不是太长了 通关后爽到"记忆融化"
items.summary: 近日，一位贴吧玩家发帖询问：“《影之刃零》的流程是不是太长了？”

content.v: 由你来说： 《影之刃零》的一周目流程算长吗？你开二周目、三周目了吗？
近日，一位贴吧玩家发帖询问：“《影之刃零》的流程是不是太长了？”
该玩家拿《生化危机》系列作比较，表示自己通关《生化危机》后，脑海中通常会留下比较清晰的流程地图：哪把钥匙对应哪扇门、哪个开关位于几楼，以及怎样规划路线、避开敌人和完成全收集。

这种对关卡结构的熟悉感，也让他有动力反复挑战，系列每一作至少都会玩上五周目。
但《影之刃零》给他的体验截然不同。虽然一周目的战斗过程十分爽快，可通关后，他已经记不清哪些钥匙和道具是推进主线时顺手获得的，哪些又是专门探索找到的，感觉整个流程在脑海里“变成了一团浆糊”。

评论区玩家对此看法不一。有人认为，游戏的一周目逆天难度已经是最好的体验，多周目反而容易失去新鲜感；也有人调侃，《生化危机》有紧迫感，玩家自然更容易记住流程，而《影之刃零》属于纯爽游，玩的时候几乎脑子关机，通关后当然很难回忆细节。

items.title: Chovy回应决赛失利：夺冠有运气成分 不能只怪自己
items.summary: GEN中单Chovy通过直播、粉丝社群和采访等渠道谈及这场失利，既表达了对结果的遗憾，也谈到了自己对比赛表现的反思。

content.v: 在S16全球总决赛决赛中，GEN不敌BLG，遗憾错失冠军。赛后，GEN中单Chovy通过直播、粉丝社群和采访等渠道谈及这场失利，既表达了对结果的遗憾，也谈到了自己对比赛表现的反思。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251711462163.png
在直播中，Chovy表示，比赛最终取得什么结果，都不是自己一个人能够左右的。他认为，能够夺冠也有运气成分，自己平时已经付出过努力，即使最终失败，也不能将所有责任都归于自己。
而在粉丝社群中，Chovy进一步谈到了自己的临场状态。他表示，决赛时自己并没有受到太多紧张和压力的影响，更多是觉得个人实力还有不足，因此认为未来仍有提升空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251711566572.png
赛后采访中，Chovy也承认，回看比赛时能发现不少操作本可以做得更好。他曾思考过，如果队伍当时采取不同的决策方向，比赛结果是否会有所改变。不过，他并没有因此失去对未来比赛的信心，表示队伍会认真分析失利原因，自己也希望将这次比赛中锻炼出的心态延续下去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251712062555.png
值得一提的是，决赛开始前，中国玩家社区中就有部分声音对Chovy的关键战表现持保留态度，并不看好他的决赛发挥。如今GEN最终不敌BLG，Chovy的表现自然也成为赛后讨论的焦点。

others.title: PS5 上的《GTA 6》玩家在第一个周末的平均游戏时间超过 17 小时

content.v: 《GTA6》第一章的慢节奏在玩家中引发讨论。有人想早点看到抢劫和大型动作场面，觉得开场太慢，也有人愿意放下主线慢慢探索。一名玩家说，自己光在第一章就玩了41小时。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795597151_736832_jpg_r.jpg
第一章的大部分时间都在Rockstar重现的佛罗里达群岛一带度过。露西亚出狱前，玩家可以钓鱼、潜水或修缮房屋。几名玩家自述在这一章待了约10小时到40多小时。那名玩了41小时的玩家刻意只逛哈姆雷特附近的几个区域，仍觉得有不少事可做。
另一名玩家估计，自己去接露西亚前花了15到18小时。他开车买橙汁、跟当地人打招呼，也去锻炼、打篮球，还试了钓鱼和潜水，想看看游戏会怎样回应这些行动。还有玩家说，开场没什么压力，他开车时愿意遵守交通规则，连转弯也会手动打灯。
一名来自佛罗里达的玩家觉得，游戏里的群岛和七英里大桥还原得很像。另一名长期关注佛罗里达群岛的玩家在第一章钓鱼、修房和锻炼，待了十几个小时。剧情在第一章末尾提速，后续章节陆续开放更多活动，也有玩家在推进剧情后开始怀念开场的平静。

content.v: 卡普空的《 怪物猎人：崛起 》现已通过Netflix Games在全球范围内原生登陆iOS和Android平台。移动版于2026年11月24日正式上线，与此前在菲律宾等地区先行测试的节奏一致。与云串流游戏不同，这款移动版直接在设备上运行，玩家在App Store或Google Play下载独立应用“怪物猎人：崛起 Netflix”后，凭借有效的Netflix会员资格即可游玩，无需额外付费，官方称其不包含广告、额外费用或内购。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261118/1794983482_181899.jpg

正如最初的公告所述，本次内容包含《怪物猎人：崛起》本体以及加入绯红辉夜天彗龙等内容的标题更新。此前作为付费或限时下载内容提供的挑战任务与活动任务，在移动版中改为随游戏进度逐步解锁，不再需要单独购买。操作层面，触控方案针对手机和平板重新设计，每种武器拥有独立的操作布局；战斗中新增的“恢复按钮”会根据猎人的生命值与状态，自动从物品栏中挑选最合适的道具。玩家可以单人 狩猎 ，也能联网组成最多四人的队伍。
需要留意的是，移动版的游戏进度通过云存档保存至Netflix个人资料，但此前已在Switch或PC等平台游玩的存档无法迁移至Netflix版。此外，大型扩展包《曙光》是否包含在移动版中，官方尚未给出明确说明，现有信息中也没有将其列入已确认的内容范围。设备要求方面，Google Play页面推荐使用骁龙8+ Gen 1或更新处理器、至少8GB运行内存的机型。
《怪物猎人：崛起》及其大型扩展包《怪物猎人：崛起：曙光》现已登陆Nintendo Switch、Steam、PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S、PlayStation 4、Xbox One和Xbox PC平台。而《怪物猎人：崛起》现已通过Netflix Games登陆iOS和Android平台。

content.v: 近日，非正经AI修仙RPG《不问凡尘》（World Apart）参加了2026 WePlay 文化展！《不问凡尘》是一款几乎百分百AI浓度的非正经3D修仙互动作品，以“真人”超写实视觉呈现修仙世界，将AI NPC互动、策略回合制战斗与自由修仙养成相结合，让道友们能够深入体验一段修仙故事。目前，《不问凡尘》在Steam好评率接近九成，获特别好评。
https://image.gcores.com/861c6583369884c828876d8ef3cec012-1266-634.png
在WePlay的展台中，《不问凡尘》开放了抢先体验后首个大版本试玩：玩家从凡人起步，体验修行日常与回合制斗法，培养自身和NPC修为，与修仙世界互动等等！现场另设 “化身工坊”，可借助AI生成自己的修士形象并当场看到效果哦~
https://image.gcores.com/f789f511149312f5a9e83358bd34e972-1268-951.jpeg
在展会期间，《不问凡尘》吸引不少路人驻足拍照，也有已购游戏的玩家到场交流。
https://image.gcores.com/2b2edca850a61ece699397001ade411b-1269-952.jpeg
值得一提的是，在本作中，玩家以凡尘修士的身份，体验角色演出、修行日常、斗法历练等内容，真实走进修仙小说中的世界、亲自参与其中。作品里的NPC有各自的性格与经历。玩家可以通过自然语言与他们交流，从闲谈中了解人物、打听消息，也可以尝试说服和交涉，在往来中发现新的机缘。面对不同的修士，同一句话也可能得到不同的回应，让每一次相遇都值得探索。
https://image.gcores.com/4ee077080d7847ba8618161eac61684a-1268-714.png
围绕修仙成长，本作还提供功法与法宝搭配系统、策略回合制战斗，以及炼丹炼器、探索寻宝等玩法。玩家可以在历练中积累自身和NPC的修为，结识性情各异的修士，在人物关系与成长选择之间，逐步走出自己的修行道路。
https://image.gcores.com/ab237f777142efca7c1b105b39b66459-1264-711.jpeg
未来，《不问凡尘》会持续更新剧情、玩法与角色互动内容。玩家可前往Steam商店了解本作，或关注官方渠道获取后续版本信息！
https://image.gcores.com/5dda8b956af3cd05348be7e608a1b115-1268-714.jpeg
