items.title: 特朗普回应介入黄仁勋回归：如有必要愿赦免老黄
items.summary: 当地时间周二，美国总统特朗普在接受媒体采访时表示，如有必要，他愿意赦免黄仁勋。但他认为，这位复职的英伟达CEO应该不需要赦免，…

content.v: 当地时间周二，美国总统特朗普在接受媒体采访时表示，如有必要，他愿意赦免黄仁勋。但他认为，这位复职的英伟达CEO应该不需要赦免，并且下周出席国会听证时应当实话实说。
特朗普曾向英伟达董事会施压，要求其重新聘用黄仁勋。周一英伟达股价大涨后，特朗普进行了一番自我表功。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250912166957.png
在接受采访时，他查看了最新行情，并指出英伟达股价在周二下午有所回升，扳回了当天早些时候的部分跌幅。
“还不错，跌了几个点，”特朗普在查看行情时评论道，“尾盘确实回升了。”
特朗普周一曾表示，是他促成了“黄仁勋的回归”。他表示，他曾直接与英伟达董事会沟通，敦促董事会让黄仁勋重新出任公司CEO。
周一美股开盘前，英伟达在官网宣布，公司重新任命黄仁勋为总裁、首席执行官、董事。声明提到，董事会已听取美国政府高层的意见。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250912279208.png
受这一消息刺激，英伟达股价周一暴涨31.48%、单日市值激增近万亿美元并刷新美股历史记录，科技股集体狂欢。不过，随着投资者乐观情绪消退，英伟达周二收跌5.86%，报155.38美元。投资者正在评估黄仁勋复职带来的影响，围绕其回归的政治和公司治理风险仍受关注。
特朗普周一还在社交媒体发文说，英伟达董事会让黄仁勋重新担任CEO一职是“正确且恰当的决定”。美国政府没有理由认为黄仁勋回归英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险。美国司法部长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明其有任何不合法行为。
如有必要愿赦免黄仁勋
目前，针对英伟达和黄仁勋的相关调查仍在持续。黄仁勋将于下周二（12月1日）接受众议院外交事务委员会问询，以及下周四（12月3日）出席参议院银行委员会听证会。一些议员预测，在面对严厉质询时，黄仁勋将援引第五修正案拒绝回答问题以避免成为对自己不利的证人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250912396271.png
特朗普认为，黄仁勋无需援引美国宪法第五修正案赋予的权利来避免自证其罪。
“我认为他不需要援引第五修正案。这对人们来说是件值得关注的事情，”特朗普表示。“我希望他实话实说，我是说，他的律师肯定会给他建议，但我一直觉得他百分之百光明磊落，你知道，他是个非常聪明的人。”
当被问及是否会赦免黄仁勋可能涉及的罪行时，特朗普回答称：“我想这总归是个选项，但我认为没必要。”
对美国政府入股英伟达持开放态度
特朗普还表示，英伟达的成功对美国保持人工智能领域的优势至关重要。他表示，他对美国政府入股英伟达持开放态度，并提到英特尔去年就曾让出相当于其价值10%的股份。
“我考虑过这件事。我说，‘你知道，也许我该这么做’，但我目前还没提出来。现在可能还不算太晚，”特朗普表示。
特朗普表示，他之所以介入并促成黄仁勋的回归，包括向其保证行政部门不会找他麻烦，是因为如果英伟达选了“错误的人”来接替黄仁勋，那“对我们国家而言，在多方面都将是一场灾难”。

content.v: Daedalic Entertainment 与 Black Deer Games 宣布，动作塔防游戏《维京防线：北境之风》将开启第二次测试。
https://image.gcores.com/c5665117fa86213d53d55975bd815ad1-1268-714.png
新玩家和曾参与首次测试的玩家现可通过 Steam 报名参加第二次测试。测试将于 12 月 2 日开启。Daedalic 同时发布了全新实机预告片，展现游戏融合塔防、策略与 RPG 式成长系统的独特玩法。
《维京防线：北境之风》Steam 页面，参与测试：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618000/Hordeguard_Winds_of_the_North/
https://image.gcores.com/f5a24cef32953ce5e08df3b9b71fdac4-1268-714.jpeg
第二次测试将加入以下新内容：
敌人突袭：探索地图时，玩家将遭遇出其不意、难以预测的敌人袭击。
10 种全新被动技能：在据点之外探索并获得被动能力，为战斗带来更多策略选择。
存档续战：玩家可以从上次推进到的敌人波次继续关卡，迅速重返战斗。
全新指挥面板：玩家可以下达命令，让士兵跟随、驻守、前往指定位置，或在合作模式中前往另一名玩家身边，在激烈战斗中更灵活地指挥部队。
新增语言支持：游戏现已支持 15 种语言，包括英语、斯洛伐克语、法语、德语、西班牙语、捷克语、俄语、简体中文和繁体中文。完整语言列表请参阅 Steam 页面。
《维京防线：北境之风》的首次测试吸引了 50,000 名玩家参与。Black Deer Games 根据玩家反馈，为游戏加入了更多功能并调整了玩法体验。
https://image.gcores.com/c86abaefafc1b9909f7aeb5a33037886-1268-714.jpeg
第二次测试还将带来男女英雄配音、箭雨与锤击技能升级、更聪明的士兵单位、可供玩家手动控制的攻击方式，以及更多样化的支线任务奖励。
在《维京防线：北境之风》中，每场战斗都是与时间的竞赛。玩家需要收集资源、扩建据点并强化防御工事，为越来越强大的神话敌人做好准备。在每次敌人进攻前，玩家都要决定离开据点的安全范围，深入探索多远。每一份资源都能帮助村庄变得更强，但探索所花费的时间也会让下一波敌人更快逼近。
无论是独自战斗，还是与好友进行本地合作，每个决定都会影响战局。玩家可以获得经验、解锁强力升级卡牌、招募战团成员，并选择成为骁勇的战士、精于建造的工匠或坚韧的防守者，在一次次猛烈攻势中调整策略、奋力求生。
https://image.gcores.com/1ae579918ddb0fdc1f4408db49f11e0f-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/dc940216f267d1155ffedc458689deff-1268-714.jpeg
游戏特色
动作战斗与塔防策略相结合：在维京生存冒险中体验即时战斗、据点建造与 RPG 成长。
建造坚固据点：收集资源、扩建村庄并升级防御工事，抵挡愈发危险的敌人攻势。
塑造你的维京英雄：通过获取经验并解锁升级卡牌，强化战斗能力、防御与策略选择。
探索北欧神话世界：在受维京传说启发的严酷世界中，对抗源源不断的神话生物。
本地合作并肩作战：与好友组队、分工合作，一起收集资源、建造防御并守护村庄。

items.title: Steam大奖现已开放提名，十款名作角逐“名作堂”大奖
items.summary: Valve 于今日宣布，2026年 Steam 大奖提名及黑五特卖现已开启。玩家可通过 Steam 主页访问 Steam 大奖提名页面，也可以访问喜爱作品的开发者发布的活动页面，为每个奖项提名一款游戏。 本次不仅有 借鉴

content.v: Valve 于今日宣布，2026年 Steam 大奖提名及黑五特卖现已开启。玩家可通过 Steam 主页访问 Steam 大奖提名页面，也可以访问喜爱作品的开发者发布的活动页面，为每个奖项提名一款游戏。 本次不仅有 借鉴自昔日门类的怀旧奖项 ，更有全新的“名作堂”奖，让玩家在 Steam 历届“年度游戏”获奖作品中选出最棒的名作。详情如下：
https://image.gcores.com/f13e072bb594c7678f0ccbf964c0a885-960-311.jpg
名作堂奖
历届年度最佳游戏奖获奖作品齐聚一堂，角逐过去 10 年最佳游戏的称号。
玩家可提名的游戏包括《GTA5》、《巫师3：狂猎》、《绝地求生》、《只狼：影逝二度》、《荒野大镖客：救赎2》、《生化危机8：村庄》、《艾尔登法环》、《博德之门3》、《黑神话：悟空》以及《空洞骑士：丝之歌》。
https://image.gcores.com/ca5287bf163fd692f4654a9812aef289-1082-618.jpg
年度最佳游戏奖 也许是因为它沉浸式的游戏打法，又或许是因为它扣人心弦的故事情节、制作精良的角色、完美无瑕的设计或让人欲罢不能的多人游戏模式。无论是出于何种原因，今年的“年度最佳游戏”大奖迅速成为了经典。
年度最佳 VR 游戏奖 年度最佳 VR 游戏可不仅仅是装扮成普通的现实。这款游戏提升了现实，并借由 VR 媒介的力量，突破着虚拟世界的边界。
爱的付出奖 此游戏推出已有一段时间。游戏团队早已过了创意成果呱呱坠地的阶段。但他们是出色的父母，继续滋养和支持着他们的创意。即便过了这么多年，直到今天，游戏仍在不断推出新内容。
最佳掌机游戏奖 这款游戏是如此绝妙，让您不论到哪里都想随身携带。因此您就这么做了！幸运的是，这款游戏在 PC 上令人不忍释手的所有元素，在随身携带时居然更加引人入胜。
再五分钟就好奖 那些让人一开始玩就停不下来的游戏，这些游戏让玩家欲罢不能，想着再来一个回合，或是撑到下一个检查点——不知不觉就到凌晨 3 点了。
无以言表奖 这些游戏很难简单进行归类：它们要么在现有类型的基础上添加了新颖有趣的功能，要么以此前少见的方式将不同类型融为一体，要么就是横空出世的新奇作品，还没有人为这种类型命名。
这活我干定了奖 这些游戏模拟了现实生活中（平凡单调）的工作，比如管理商店、修剪草坪，或是其他如果真要在现实生活中进行绝对毫无趣味可言的任务。
独乐乐不如众乐乐奖 有的游戏，您自己一个人玩时感觉完全不同。也许您需要有个朋友为您两肋插刀，也许您需要有个朋友被您刀插两肋。不管怎样，这款游戏能让您呼朋唤友，共享欢乐。
杰出视觉风格奖 视觉风格并不追求栩栩如生的图形保真度（虽然这本身是个崇高的目标）……它意味着整个游戏呈现一种独特的风格和观感。
纵使手残仍大爱奖 这款游戏奖励意志力，拒绝玻璃心。这是我们爱过的最难的游戏。
最佳原声音轨奖 这位默默无闻的英雄值得因其出色的配乐而获得认可。这就是 OST 之最！
杰出剧情游戏奖 有时候，只有剧情丰富的游戏才能拨动心弦，而这款游戏故事情节丰富无比。它像所有肥皂剧一样引人入胜，和优秀剧本一样精雕细琢。能让我们有所感触，干得漂亮！
轻松惬意奖 这款游戏是忙碌日子的解药。它打起来顺手，玩起来轻松，让您的烦恼通通烟消云散。这款游戏为您带来禅意时刻。

items.title: 巫师3到巫师4巨大进化！CDPR放话：堪比GTA从5到6
items.summary: 据VGC报道，CD Projekt Red（CDPR）表示，《巫师3：狂猎》与《巫师4》之间的进步幅度，将与《给他爱5》到《GTA6》的跨代提升相当。

content.v: 据VGC报道，CD Projekt Red（CDPR）表示，《巫师3：狂猎》与《巫师4》之间的进步幅度，将与《给他爱5》到《GTA6》的跨代提升相当。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250843456679.jpg
这一消息来自CDPR最新的投资者会议。会上，公司高层被问及了大量与Rockstar新作《GTA6》有关的问题。该作发售后取得了巨大成功，创下了娱乐产业史上规模最大的首发纪录。
一位投资者在提问中，将《巫师4》与成功发售的《GTA6》进行了比较。对此，CDPR高层虽然强调两款游戏存在差异，但也认为二者之间确实有值得比较的地方。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250843521879.jpg
CDPR联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski表示：“首先，这次会议讨论的是我们自己，而不是Rockstar，不过我理解大家为什么会将两者联系起来。我不会深入分析，也不会全面评测《给他爱5》和《GTA6》之间的区别，但我们确实关注了这款游戏，也看到了其中的变化。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250843595752.jpg
“我们认为，《巫师3：狂猎》到《巫师4》之间也将实现类似幅度的跨越。距离上一部作品已经过去了11年。我们正在努力让《巫师4》在画面表现上实现显著提升，并在游戏几乎所有可能的方面进行改进。”
“所以，是的，你们应该期待《巫师3：狂猎》与《巫师4》之间会有一次更大幅度的飞跃。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250844072985.jpg
随后，投资者又提出了更多与《GTA6》有关的问题。不过，CDPR强调，公司并未因为《GTA6》的发售而调整《巫师4》的开发计划。目前游戏仍按计划定于2028年发售，但官方尚未公布更加具体的日期。

items.title: Steam社区市场再度迎来大更新
items.summary: 早些时候,V社为 Steam 社区市场带来了重大升级，包含了新的物品页面、挂单和搜索功能，以便更好地利用游戏提供的物品数据。为了让玩家更好地使用新内容，官方于日前推出了崭新的市场主页，以及围绕物品追踪和挂单管理的一系列改

content.v: 早些时候,V社为 Steam 社区市场带来了重大升级，包含了新的物品页面、挂单和搜索功能，以便更好地利用游戏提供的物品数据。为了让玩家更好地使用新内容，官方于日前推出了崭新的市场主页，以及围绕物品追踪和挂单管理的一系列改进。以下是更新内容：
全新的市场主页
我们重新打造了市场主页，加载速度更快，向用户呈现的也是其游戏中相关性最高的物品。“热门物品”栏目只包含了成百上千万件物品中的一小部分，且内容常年如一，而人气蹿升的物品则可以让用户一览自己当前所玩游戏中有什么新内容。
游戏链接移到了顶部的位置并进行了个性化处理，因此用户看到的不再是没有主次之分且一成不变的列表，而是可以快速访问自己最有可能感兴趣的物品。
https://image.gcores.com/64aacb728649bd6a9532e229259a0362-1329-1211.png
我的关注列表
以前，留意关注几件物品意味着要添加大量的书签或者反复大量地进行搜索。全新的市场关注列表让用户可以从市场主页快速访问自己保存的内容。可以保存的内容有：
特定挂单
物品类型，包括已经应用的筛选条件
搜索的内容，包括筛选条件和搜索文本
如果用户在等待符合一系列特定筛选条件的特定物品，则只需设置筛选条件一次，即可随时查看搜索结果。关注列表条目可以设置自定义名称，这样有助于区分两个已保存且相似的搜索条件。关注列表还可以随意地重新排序。
Steam 社区物品
此外大家还可以看到一个新栏目，着重显示自己所玩游戏的 Steam 社区物品（集换式卡牌、表情动作及个人资料背景）。
用户正在获取的所有徽章都会在此展示，从而可以轻松地收集剩余卡牌。
https://image.gcores.com/34f4c010bde69b8437f1f0c06eecafa0-1241-481.png
无需重新挂单即可变更价格
大家现在可以给当前的挂单重新定价了，只需选择一个新价格，一切大功告成。
https://image.gcores.com/948a6bd5aa1f72ea017123007a00a321-1026-550.png
列表视图
现在，搜索结果和出售/求购挂单除了有卡片视图，还新增了列表视图选项。
https://image.gcores.com/c34ed7ed4124c50af49a28cc27411918-830-395.png
用手机进行确认更简单
要通过 Steam 手机应用买卖物品吗？如果该设备也是 Steam 令牌手机验证器所在的设备，则应用现在会要求进行内联确认，无需离开市场并前往“确认”页面。通过手机应用进行买卖现在应该会顺畅得多。
https://image.gcores.com/1f21252e8cbae5b64bcdfb767f160a05-293-463.png
还有更多更新如下：
“我当前的挂单”和“我的市场历史记录”现在有自己的专属页面，并在市场主页提供概要。
现在提供“人气蹿升”（也就是新近变得热门的物品）作为搜索结果及求购/出售挂单的排序选项。
出售对话框进行了更新，采用更新的图表，改善了移动设备上的易用性。
《反恐精英》武器箱现在会显示其中可能包含的内容并提供链接。
“按热门程度排序”和“按价格排序”现在返回的结果更准确，也更快。
所有市场相关页面加载速度更快，响应更迅捷。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611250824381153.png
CI Games创始人兼首席执行官Marek Tyminski表示：“《堕落之王2》将于2027年4月发售，具体发售日期将在12月公布。”

content.v: 日本主播Haigure Tamao在《GTA6》中实测发现，角色带着六星通缉穿过一处彩蛋传送门，抵达复刻的《侠盗猎车：罪恶 都市 》场景后，通缉立即清零。他随后返回现代的莱奥尼达，确认界面仍显示零星。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795564651_718776_jpg_r.jpg
Rockstar在《侠盗猎车手5》中移除了第六颗通缉星，并在本作恢复六星通缉。玩家平时可以靠换装、换车或躲藏摆脱追捕，到了六星，连驾驶喷气式飞机也会遭到导弹攻击。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795564652_704634_jpg_r.jpg
Haigure Tamao在油管视频中记录了测试过程。第一次尝试时，他很难在追捕中活下来。随后，他利用另一个与总统秘密掩体有关的彩蛋取得坦克，在发电站附近把通缉升至六星，并赶在传送门关闭前进入。
这处与汤米·维塞蒂有关的传送门彩蛋涉及莱奥尼达的12座变电站。完成解谜后，玩家可在游戏时间晚上7点至次日早上6点进入龟头发电站内的传送门。角色杰森穿过入口后会来到复刻的马里布俱乐部，场景采用PS2时代的画面风格，肯特·保罗也会登场。目前尚不清楚Rockstar是否有意让这处彩蛋清除通缉。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》玩家批评杰森和女友的关系在单独探索时掉的太快 会影响游戏结局
items.summary: 近日《GTA6》玩家发现，杰森和露西亚在游戏中的关系存在一个重大缺陷。这个问题主要集中在游戏机制上，而非叙事层面，但仍然值得一提。杰森与露西亚的故事基本兑现了Rockstar此前宣传的“邦妮与克莱德”式情侣搭档设定。《G

content.v: 近日《GTA6》玩家发现，杰森和露西亚在游戏中的关系存在一个重大缺陷。这个问题主要集中在游戏机制上，而非叙事层面，但仍然值得一提。
杰森与露西亚的故事基本兑现了Rockstar此前宣传的“邦妮与克莱德”式情侣搭档设定。《GTA6》的媒体评测也普遍称赞了游戏对这对情侣的塑造，两人的性格对比鲜明相互衬托，为游戏增添了不少乐趣。不过，玩家希望Rockstar未来能够改进其中一个细节。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795563776_260586_jpg_r.jpg
Reddit用户kingoflint282发帖指出，如果玩家在自由模式中长时间单独操控杰森或露西亚，两人的关系值就会下降得非常快。该玩家表示，自己只是在游戏中与另一半分开活动了大约一天，就收到了两人关系恶化的提示。不少网友对此表示认同，认为游戏对关系值的惩罚过于严苛。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795564241_748676_jpg_r.jpg
显然，R星希望玩家大部分时间都能让杰森和露西亚一起行动。两人组队完成大多数活动会更加轻松，而且彼此之间的互动和对话也让游戏体验更加丰富。不过，目前玩家普遍认为，这套关系系统的平衡性存在问题，玩家偶尔想单独行动，不应该受到如此严厉的惩罚。
部分玩家还指出，通过游戏内手机与另一半联系，可以在一定程度上缓解关系恶化的问题，但目前仍有不少玩家没有意识到这一机制。
之所以这一问题值得重视，是因为《GTA6》的结局会受到杰森与露西亚关系值的影响。虽然这里不涉及具体剧透，但如果玩家希望解锁剧情中的某些特定走向，就必须让两人的关系维持在较好的状态，也就是“Crazy in Love（坠入爱河）”和“Hot Together（如胶似漆）”这两个等级。
如果关系值已经下降，玩家仍然可以通过让两人一起外出、共同犯罪等方式重新改善关系，但这个过程可能需要花费不少时间。
目前，Rockstar正在收集玩家反馈，为后续《GTA6》更新做准备。游戏发售时间尚短，开发团队是否会按照玩家的建议调整关系系统，目前还不得而知。不过，杰森与露西亚在自由模式中的关系值下降速度显然是可以调整的，希望Rockstar能够在后续更新中解决这一问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261125/1795563777_791478_jpg_r.jpg

items.title: CD Projekt 老板表示，《巫师 3》和《巫师 4》之间的差异将与《GTA 5》和《GTA 6》“相当”：“我的意思是，已经过去 11 年了”
items.summary: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6.

content.v: CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6. While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way.

"Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences.

"Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4."

Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time.
Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JG6brzcCtL4wRDdMBaAvf6.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KuLEK2cmke8MvaewCLhme6.jpg

At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do."

He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason.

"You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero."

Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments."

"I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.'

"They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that."

Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.)

seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed
The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030.

items.summary: GTA 6's first chapter has been somewhat divisive due to its slower pace, but it's also a part of the game that

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-jason-beached-1795560006962.jpg
Warning: This article features light spoilers for the early hours of GTA 6 .

GTA 6's first chapter has been somewhat divisive due to its slower pace, but it's also a part of the game that some fans have spent dozens of hours playing due to it highly immersive slice-of-life elements.

Instead of throwing you headfirst into crazy heists or explosive set pieces, the first chapter of GTA 6 is largely spent bumbling around Rockstar's version of the Florida Keys. You can go fishing, scuba diving, and even fix up your house before Lucia's release from prison. It's an exceptionally low-key and chill opening to a game filled with all kinds of crazy action, which is why it's also rubbed some people the wrong way. They don't want to do chores or kick it on the beach; they want to cause some mayhem.

However, for others, this has become an unexpected hook for GTA 6 that actually delayed their interest in getting to the meat of Rockstar's open-world epic. Various fans of the game have said they spent anywhere from 10 to as many as 40+ hours in just Chapter 1 alone. Keep in mind, this is a sliver of the overall experience, and much of the game's most interesting activities don't get added until subsequent chapters. However, some players just enjoyed living inside of this part of the game before things go horribly wrong and they're forced to start ramping up the violence and crime.

"Best thing about that early chapter is just how low stakes and casual it feels," said X user @CS11__ after spending 41 hours in Chapter 1 alone. "I forced myself not to go farther than Hamlet, so I really only ever experienced these two small areas in 40 hours. [...] The game hardly opened up, but it still felt unbelievably rich and fun."

But... what is it these people are actually doing, if not blowing stuff up and creating tons of chaos? Some fans were just going through the motions, giving themselves daily routines that involved working out, taking on relaxing hobbies, and exploring.

"[A] lot of roleplaying, day-to-day living type stuff," said Aaron Espionza on X , who estimated that he spent around 15–18 hours before picking up Lucia from prison. "I had a routine even when I would wake up, drive to the juice bar down the street, get my orange juice, and then say hello to the locals. If anyone said anything mean, I would get violent and throw empty juice cups at them. [I] did the workout routines. Basketball was a favorite of mine. Side stuff with Cal fishing, Donnie pick-ups, and scuba. But so much of it was testing how much detail Rockstar put into it. 'If I do this , will they do that ?' type of systems exploration. Always came away surprised."

X user @scaasm noted that the lower stakes nature of Chapter 1 even prompted him to follow traffic laws and use manual turn signals in GTA 6: "I follow traffic laws unless I'm doing something criminal, and generally just taking it very slow. [I'm] loving every moment."

The location itself was also a big driving point for a lot of fans, some of whom have personal connections or apprecation for its real life counterpart: "As someone from Florida, I think the Keys is one of those locations that they absolutely nailed (waning sands outlets too; they look exactly like the Orlando ones)," said @piterparker69 on X . "It felt kinda uncanny driving around (especially the 7 Mile Bridge) because of how good it replicates real life."

"I have been obsessed with the Florida Keys for the last 5 years, and finding out you spend the start of the game there, catching fish, fixing my house, working out, and just vibing gave me little motivation to move on," said @AnchormanV2 on X after spending roughly a dozen hours in Chapter 1.

"I took my sweet time in Key Lento, not necessarily to avoid progressing the story, but more so [bcause] I was just having so much fun exploring the keys and just taking it all in," said X user @HorrorUntitled . "There’s just so much to see to see and happening. It’s very overwhelming."

Of course, some people did get into a bit of open-world crime as well, or explore a bit beyond the Keys, but a lot of it was still a result of the story feeling low-stakes and not having much urgency in its first chaper. X user Ryan Ranc even noted that he would go around Key Lento acting as a vigilante: "I’m playing as Batman and roaming at night on my motorbike stopping crime."

Chapter 1 in GTA 6 is a very interesting piece of the game, and some even noted that they longed for that tranquility after moving on in the story. It's an intentional slow burn, as things get turned up to an 11 at the end of the chapter and make you come to appreciate what you had. It's the calm before the storm in many ways, and some people are really basking in that.

items.title: Nvidia 补丁最终消除了 SSD 锤击错误，其上一个修补程序实际上并未修复
items.summary: "The evil is defeated."

content.v: Nvidia's latest GeForce Game Ready driver, version 621.40 , is out now. "This new Game Ready Driver provides the best gaming experience for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, and Assetto Corsa Rally," the notes say, "and the addition of DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering to Where Winds Meet."

Which is kind of burying the lead. This patch is really a hotfix for a hotfix, an update that finally addresses the bug with previous driver packages that had them pointlessly rewriting a log file over and over, quickly adding up to tens of GB every hour and potentially damaging SSDs nobody can afford to replace any more.

Over the weekend Nvidia released a hotfix that supposedly caught the bug, only for users to discover it merely delayed its onset . Rather than setting in immediately after a reboot, it would wait until your PC had been on for a while before shitting the bed. If you're one of the people who leaves your computer running overnight then I hope you stayed on version 621.01, the last safe driver package before the current one.

Forum users have been testing out version 621.40 and it seems to have not only stopped the Nvidia container service from freaking out and rewriting its log, but also caught a bug with custom cursors that would make them turn gray. Which is nice.

I'm tempted to play it safe and stay on my old driver anyway, though I'll update for Dawn of War 4, which comes out on December 3. People with the Commander Edition can jump in early on November 30, and readers in the US and UK can enter our competition to win a Steam code for the Commander Edition right now .

items.title: 将 GTA 6 移植到 PC 的竞赛解释
items.summary: GTA 6 could be a PC game (illegally) in a matter of days.

content.v: Things are moving fast. Now that an illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 is out in the wild, anonymous modders are racing to port it to PC, and the work is progressing faster than many expected. At this rate, it's possible that a static recompilation of GTA 6 will run on a PC in a matter of days. It's also possible it will take much longer to produce a playable build that's actually on par with the console versions.

What we do know for sure is that Rockstar is taking notice and has already begun cracking down on the highest-profile projects. As always, downloading pirated software is illegal and can infect your PC with malware, and that last bit is doubly true in the dubious AI era we now live in.
For now, the only thing to do is observe and report. Here's where things stand with GTA 6 PC ports.
Does GTA 6 currently run on PC?
No.

Several projects have made it as far as booting the game and using menus, and at least one has seemingly managed to move around in-game with bugged out lighting , but it's hard to verify clips making the rounds when so many are obvious fakes .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/i8yFwHmtrjiByMrpBUfAhf-1920-80.jpg
Who is working on GTA 6 PC recomps?

Dozens of groups of anonymous modders and vibecoders. So many, in fact, that several websites dedicated to tracking the progress of GTA 6 recomp efforts have also appeared. One of the tracker sites, Portwatch VI , has a list of projects ranked by their "playable" completion percentage—best not to take those made up figures as an accurate estimate of when a port will be complete. The top five are:
Until very recently, the Leonida project was among those making impressive progress, but the group's creator (a 15-year-old) quit the project after Rockstar got its Discord server taken down.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/iWTjerdRXEaUkNM8qhZn87-1920-80.jpg
How did we get here?

Every GTA 6 recomp project is based on the same thing: An illicit Xbox build of GTA 6 released online by Cyberleek , the notorious leaker who previously shared video of a GTA 6 development build months before its release.
With GTA 6 being the biggest game in the world at the moment and not available on PC, there is an outsized motivation to get it running.
What is a recomp, and why is this possible so quickly?

A recomp refers to static recompilation, which is the result of reverse-engineering a game's code to make it run on other hardware (usually a PC). If you want to read further on how that's achieved, PCG alum Wes Fenlon's excellent Read Only Memo newsletter has what you're looking for.

As for how GTA 6 ports (and ports for other new games) are coming together so quickly, the answer is AI. The advent of AI coding tools like Claude have greatly expedited the work required to create a static recompilation of games on another platform. What used to take months to years now takes hours to days. Recomps that heavily use AI are often buggier, messier, and have fewer features than human-made fan projects, but they are fast and functional.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DHupw3zsDFv4RvF7fLXLPV-1920-80.jpg
Will a hypothetical GTA 6 PC recomp perform as well as an official PC port?
It's way too early to speak in absolutes, but I'm comfortable assuming that the first "playable" recomps will require an exceptionally powerful PC.

That guess is based on GTA 6 being an obviously demanding game and also some recent precedent: The earliest Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake recomps that've appeared online have high system requirements to perform as well as it does natively on Switch 2—and, well, GTA 6 has a lot more happening under the hood than a 28-year-old Zelda game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HYbPpv7TicCXGFGtDRqP4D-1920-80.jpg
Is Rockstar gonna release the real PC port early in response?

That's the big question. My money is on no, it won't. To switch up plans on a dime would assume that Rockstar is sitting on a polished PC version that it could put out any day, and I'm not convinced that's the case. The current rumor, preceding all of this leak business, is that the PC version of GTA 6 is planned for Q1 2027 (so anytime before April).
That's not to say Rockstar couldn't expedite the process if it wanted to—they certainly have the resources to achieve the unlikely.

items.title: 暗黑破坏神 4 下一季开始时，粉丝最喜爱的《暗黑破坏神 2》周年纪念 Boss 和物品不会消失
items.summary: Most of the secrets from the current season aren't going anywhere.

content.v: According to every Diablo 4 player known to man, I screwed up by skipping its last season . Blizzard shoved just about every iconic Diablo 2 boss and item it could think of into the modern game, and, by all accounts, it was one of the best seasons it ever had.
Even though the Season of Hell's Legacy is about to come to an end, Blizzard has delivered good news for me and everyone else who missed it: Most of it will remain in the game permanently.

On December 1, when the Season of Tyrael's Gambit begins, all of the unique Prime Evil boss fights will still be available, along with the Diablo world boss, Moophisto, and a handful of Diablo 2-inspired items, including the Hellfire Torch Charm. However, the craftable items, like the Enigma chest piece that gives you a free teleport skill, will not carry over.

Even without all the craftable unique items, that's quite a lot of stuff to keep around. Blizzard tends to ditch seasonal additions as soon as a new season starts, and you usually have to wait a while to see them slipped back into the game in a slightly altered form. The overwhelming excitement around the Diablo 2 content must've convinced Blizzard it was worth putting in the work to keep them around.

I would've been happy if the portal to Tristram , the rickety old town at the center of Diablo 2, was all that came back. Blizzard pulled off an incredibly faithful remake of it, complete with the old guitar theme and the voice of the blacksmith Griswold. And if you follow the hidden steps to make the Hellfire Torch, you'll be able to visit Uber Tristram, a special version of the town where you can square off against all three of the series' major villains, the Prime Evils, at once.

Diablo 4 was always kind of light on hidden quests and bosses, so it's nice to see that Blizzard found a way to bring an important part of the series back. I'll be curious to see what else comes to the game over the next three years before Diablo 5 arrives. The Amazon class will drop next year, but no expansions are planned to fill the gap. Hopefully Blizzard will take this opportunity to experiment with more things like the Diablo 2 anniversary secrets before it moves onto the sequel.

items.title: 马拉松的新跑步者外壳是一个想要伤害你的喷气推进机器人武士
items.summary: Sounds great!

content.v: We're just a couple weeks away from Marathon's Symbiosis update , a hefty overhaul patch that's aiming to inject some juice into the shooter's live service appeal with the addition of PvE roguelite and Team Deathmatch modes, new weapons, and even a social hub for hanging out with fellow runners and testing guns at the firing range.

And that's all great. But today, Bungie dropped a new cinematic that presents its strongest argument for why Symbiosis should have our attention: You can play as a terrifying, sports-car scarlet robot samurai with a sword arm and jet legs.

While Bungie previously revealed Bishop, the new runner shell arriving with Symbiosis, in the update's first gameplay trailer earlier this month, the new cinematic provides a strong sense of the power fantasy it's trying to capture. By which I mean Bungie clearly wants you to feel like a nightmarish apex predator. Like a xenomorph if a xenomorph was bright red and had cool space guns.

As the trailer progresses, we watch as a team of runners is steadily cut down by a Bishop shell's unflinching onslaught: First, one of its members is culled after taking one of Bishop's throwable hacking knives to the neck, which seems to disrupt the target's functions. The next is blasted out of midair while trying to zipline away to safety. The third is hounded by autopistol fire into a position where they can be conveniently pounced on from above.

But the trailer's peak moment happens as the Bishop prepares to loot one of its kills and is winged by a bullet from a nearby Rook, who evidently hoped to clean up after watching the whole fight pan out. This is proven to be a mistake, because the Bishop settles into a crouch, extending a plasma-edged sword blade from between its knuckles and engaging the jet thrusters in its calves.

You know that thing in samurai movies where a swordsman does a lunging slash, leaving the body of his opponent to realize that it's been cut down behind him? It's like that. But with robots and jet propulsion. Marathon's going to have iaijutsu, is what I'm saying. Something for us all to look forward to.
Marathon's Symbiosis update lands on December 8.

items.title: 暗黑破坏神 4 第 16 季解决了地狱潮汐的最大问题之一
items.summary: Diablo 4 Season 16: Season of Tyrael's Gambit officially kicks off on December 1. We finally know a bit more a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/07/25/whoopi-goldberg-key-to-hell-1721913377329.jpg

Diablo 4 Season 16: Season of Tyrael's Gambit officially kicks off on December 1. We finally know a bit more about what the new season holds in store, and it's going to make one of the biggest activities much less of a pain.

Season 15, Hell's Legacy, is a tough act to follow. It brought in a ton of nostalgic content like the Prime Evils, runewords, and even Whimsyshire. It does seem like a lot of that anniversary content is going to be retired (I'll miss runewords), but at least it seems like Season of Tyrael's Gambit is going to make farming Helltides a bit less annoying.

In the patch notes for the new season , Blizzard says one Helltide will always be up in the vanilla zones, with another active in either Nahantu or Skovos, offset by 30 minutes. In practice, that means there will always be an active Helltide. That would be good enough on its own, but Blizzard is also changing the way Abberant Cinders work. Instead of expiring at the end of each Helltide, Blizzard is introducing a cap, and will let you carry cinders between Helltides.

For the uninitiated, that might not seem like a big deal, but it's a massive quality-of-life change. If you're not aware, Helltide is essentially an in-game invasion event, where demons overrun an area in the open world. You go in and kill demons for 55 minutes to get Abberant Cinders, which you can then use to unlock chests scattered throughout the zone. Helltides have always been one of the best ways to farm XP, and there have been several seasons that revolve entirely around them.

Now that War Plans, which were introduced with Lord of Hatred, are such a central part of how Diablo 4's gameplay loop works, there's always a chance that you're going to need to do bit of Helltide farming to progress. The problem was that Helltides spawned on a timer, and there was always a 5-minute gap between them. That doesn't sound too bad, but sometimes a Helltide would pop up in your to-do list and you'd either zone in with a mere 10 minutes to gather a ton of Cinders, or there simply wouldn't be a Helltide active. This new change solves both of those problems.

Now, even if you go into a Helltide with just a few minutes remaining, you can still gather Cinders without having to worry about opening 250 Cinders worth of chests before the timer expires. You can simply farm until the Helltide moves and then teleport to the next one. Easy. It's such a seemingly small change, but it's made me more excited for the 16th season of this ARPG than anything I've heard about it so far.

Beyond that, the Season of Tyrael's Gambit also brings changes to War Plans, where you'll be able to customize them to favor the activities you actually like doing. So, if you hate Helltide, even with the new changes, it sounds like you'll be able to make them appear a little less often in your War Plans.

The new season will also have a new item type called Horadric Items, which will synergize with set talismans. In the example Blizzard shared in its post, this could be as simple as adding +1 set count to your talismans to an ability that is only activated if you have a certain set of talismans equipped.

Seasons like this are a prime example of the way Blizzard will support Diablo 4 going forward, now that Diablo 5 is in the works. Diablo 4's director has come out and reassured fans that the game will continue to get new seasons as long as people are playing , and with how different Diablo 5 sounds so far , it's possible that Diablo 4 will have a long life ahead of it.

items.title: 一名《Among Us》玩家和他的妈妈帮助营救了一名被绑架失踪一年多的女孩
items.summary: After connecting in the game, the teens began talking on Discord, which ultimately led to the discovery of her

content.v: A 17-year-old girl who had been missing for more than a year was rescued and returned home by the FBI after a friend she made while playing Among Us, and his mother, were able to track down her location and pass it along to law enforcement.

Landon Tresp told the BBC that he and the anonymous girl "kind of just clicked" when they started chatting online while playing Among Us. She eventually told Tresp she was a runaway who'd been held against her will for more than a year. After learning more, Tresp, 16, told his mother, Khristina, about the exchange; she was initially suspicious, but after speaking with the girl directly on Discord and reading reports of her disappearance, she took action, asking for a piece of mail or document with a full name on it, which the girl provided.

With that, Khristina began digging into tax and property records to find relevant addresses, which she then used to find photos on real estate sites. She showed the photos to the missing girl on Discord, who picked out the one where she was being held; with that information in hand, Khristina contacted the girl's mother on social media and spoke to her briefly on the telephone, and also received a call from the FBI asking if she could confirm that the girl was still alive.
"I said: 'I have; I video chatted with her, I've seen her'," Khristina told the BBC. "And she goes 'Oh my God, I cannot believe any of this'."

The kidnapped girl contacted Khristina the following morning, after her alleged captor, 39-year-old Adam Hunter Harmel, had left the house. In a conversation monitored by the FBI, she said she'd met Harmel on social media, where he'd pretended to be disabled and offered to pay her to help him get from Utah to Oregon. When he picked her up, however, he threw her phone into a river, then drove her to Oregon.

The girl told Khristina that she was kept in his basement and forced to sleep against the wall in his bed, while he kept a knife under his pillow to prevent escape. He gave her a mobile phone that wasn't able to make calls but could connect to wifi, which is how she was able to play online and eventually reach out for help.

While Harmel was out, law enforcement began monitoring his street and house; when the moment came, police had Khristina tell the victim that it was time to make her escape. She was able to leave the house safely and into the custody of state troopers, while Harmel was subsequently arrested and charged with transportation with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity.

A social media post by the Salt Lake City FBI confirmed the outcome, although the crucial role played by Landon and Khristina Tresp was omitted: It says only that "the FBI and the Rich County Sheriff’s Office have been actively investigating this case for more than a year and pursuing every lead received from across the US and in other countries."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5vTNYec9eJ3WoeUHxy2nzX-1920-80.png

A separate Department of Justice press release , however, acknowledges that "on Nov. 1, the FBI received a tip about the possible location of the minor victim and that the victim met Harmel on a social media application in May 2025."

Khristina and Landon have remained in daily contact with the girl they helped rescue, and they're trying to arrange an in-person meetup as well. "Sometimes we just sit on video chat, just so she knows she has someone that cares," Khristina said. "She was on video last night when I cooked dinner …it's nice to know that when she has a bad day or a bad moment, she can call me right away or call Landon right away. She's doing great for what she's gone through."

items.title: “疯狂的秘密”——GTA 6 配音演员透露了 Rockstar 的“巨大”保密协议的细节
items.summary: A voice actor who appeared in GTA 6 described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-voice-actor-reveals-nda-1795552285222.jpg
A voice actor who appeared in GTA 6 described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working on the game, calling the project “crazy secretive.”

Issa Lopez is a voice actor who plays a radio host on GTA 6’s fictional Cocoteo FM radio station, a Latin channel that plays reggaeton and dembow tracks featuring Spanish-speaking artists from the Caribbean and Latin America.

In a November 20 interview with Page Six , Lopez revealed that she recorded her lines for the station as recently as September 2026, and said the NDA she was made to sign before officially performing the part was comparable to the process of purchasing a home or a vehicle.

“Have you ever signed papers to buy a house? To buy a car? You know, it’s thick! It was a pretty humongous pack of papers that came with it. But I mean, it’s worth it! And I didn’t have to wait like all these other folks. Some of these folks have been working on this for like 10–11 years, you know what I mean?” she said.

She went on to describe the recording process for her lines, saying that she hadn’t seen anything until the day of the performance. With no time to prepare, she was essentially “put on the spot” — but she was so excited about the opportunity that she didn’t mind.

“In my usual voiceover gigs — let’s say you want me to do a commercial for you. I get a Zoom [link] maybe the day before, maybe the same day I get the script,” she explained. “Everything was like, popped up on the screen. It was mad cool. It was like, ‘You ready? And I’m like, ‘Uh-huh.’ You press a button and then boop, it pops on the screen, they say hello, and there’s a bunch of people in your ear. And they’re like, ‘Okay, here it is,’ and that’s when you see it. You are put on the spot. And you better bring it. And after that, I don’t know — whatever was in front of my face disappeared. “

Lopez revealed that she wasn’t told what the project was for, but figured it out based on context clues from an email titled “heard by millions,” saying she “read it and knew what it was for.” She also didn’t know that Bad Bunny would be co-hosting the Cocoteo station alongside her, leading to a wild realization once Rockstar released the radio stations before the game actually came out.

“We knew nothing. I saw the liners, and when I saw the liners I was like, ‘Okay, I know why I got the gig.’ ‘Cause it was like Puerto Rican dot com. It was super easy. But it was so cool, because Rockstar let me be myself. …they were like, ‘Issa, we want natural. Whatever you got, we want,'" she said.

The actors in GTA 6 were extremely secretive about their involvement in the project. Most notably, actress Manni L. Perez, who plays Lucia, was under immense pressure after fans sleuthed her social media accounts and figured out it was her before she could officially reveal the information. Now, she’s up for best performance at The Game Awards, which is one of eight nominations the game has secured mere weeks before the show takes place this December.

Other performers who have finally revealed their involvement in the game are Mandy’s actress, Lexie Shoaibi , as well as the voice and performance artist for Jason Duval, Dylan Rourke . Rockstar released the full credits for the game, too, which you can check out here — just beware of spoilers if you haven’t finished it yet.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: 《赛博朋克 2》仍有出路，但 CD Projekt Red 表示其 RPG 未来会更快推出
items.summary: We are still two years out from The Witcher 4, but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG co

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/26/ss-b20689e73e3ac19bcc5fad2c18d0353c769de144-1920x1080-1764175642324.jpg

We are still two years out from The Witcher 4 , but Ciri's big breakout adventure isn't the only massive RPG cooking at CD Projekt Red. It sounds like development on Cyberpunk 2 is carrying on smoothly, though it's still very early in its development cycle.

In a November 24 earnings call , CD Projekt Red VP of Strategy & Investor Relations Karolina Gnaś said the team is "making good progress with Cyberpunk 2, we are happy with where we are, but it's still too early to give a specific date and plan on when we will move onto full production." Although she couldn't provide a clear date when we'll hear more about the game, she did add that the studio plans to have around 200 developers by the end of 2026 and 320 by the end of next year.

It is admittedly a bit early to expect any kind of information about the Cyberpunk sequel, but it has been simmering in the background since at least 2022 , and it sounds like CD Projekt Red wants to speed up development of its massive RPGs. In its consolidated earnings report , CD Projekt Red admitted that most of its games "normally take 3 to 6 years to produce," mostly due to working on one game at a time. But that strategy has since changed.

In that same report, the company said, "At the moment, the CD Projekt Red studio is working in parallel on several productions (also in collaboration with external development teams) and supporting products, which is expected to translate into shorter intervals between the releases of subsequent titles in the future." Whether or not that new timeline will affect Cyberpunk 2 is the question.

But even if that faster development timeline is in effect for Cyberpunk 2, it's likely we'll still have to wait a while to actually see it in the wild. In an earnings report last year, when Cyberpunk 2 entered pre-production, CD Projekt CEO Michał Nowakowski suggested that CDPR's games take four or five years to move from pre-production to release, which would put the game somewhere in 2030 or 2031. And given that the game still hasn't entered full production, it isn't likely we're going to see some sort of rapid release after the Witcher 4 in 2028.

We're probably going to be waiting a little while longer for Cyberpunk 2, but it's already sounding like the game is taking shape. Just last month, associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a lot of the developers working on Cyberpunk 2 are former modders. Sasko went on to claim that "the modding community is really keeping [Cyberpunk 2077] alive," so hopefully that energy translates to Cyberpunk 2 – whenever it comes out.

items.title: GTA 6 早期最值得入手的独特武器：获得一些无需价格标签的消音武器
items.summary: There are tons of unique and collectible weapons in GTA 6 but these are the best and easiest to snap up early

content.v: GTA 6 has a ton of unique weapon variants all with their own names and mods. They're all special custom builds of stock guns and weapons with unique skins, but some of them are way more worth the trouble to hunt down than others. You'll find some of them easily—every Ammu-Nation has a unique gun sitting out for you to buy. The best unique weapons are a little more hidden. There are treasure hunts and easter eggs and a whole lot that you'll grab by fighting your way through a gang hideout.
Best unique weapons to get early
⭐ Assassin Nipper .38
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vFb5EmxDHT3kC7agWHpMcL-1920-80.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/H4MFut6eiRFJM6Cmf7D7Dc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nqSZYiCkz6jsFpDgft4Zrk-1920-80.jpg

This is the easiest unique weapon to grab right at the start of the game and totally worth the boat ride to grab it. There isn't even any combat to get to it, like many of these other uniques. The Assassin Nipper comes with a suppressor attachment, which is a really expensive mod to buy early in the game. Pick it up as soon as you've got free range in Key Lento from an old shipwreck in the Permit Keys near the military base location .
Kingfishers Laird 350
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/L2QBoRDbfJDDYnxCk4UhT5-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/X4SkAMJDtEcWpjDvRWzDp9-1920-80.png

Another great Chapter 1 snag is this sniper rifle at a Kingfisher hideout. The combat to get it is minimal (don't get between that tiger and its prey) so it's easy to pick up early. It's a bolt action that can't equip a silencer, so it isn't exactly a stealth tool, but it can help Jason pick off gangsters in a hideout before even going inside. It comes with a stock and a basic dot sight.
⭐ Scrapper VF5C
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/a2QtKXhhPPfPmG2zwL2t6h-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qjiaZNHaCPw9AAvY7nK4Vc-1920-80.png

A variant of the Vom Feur V5FC, found in Port Gellhorn at a Kolt gang hideout. It's up on the top floor of the motel by the La Cascara Motel safe , so you pretty much have to complete this illegal operation to grab it. I recommend coming up the south stairwell that's less guarded and hugging the outer walkways to get most of the way to the loot room by stealth. It's worth it though. The Scrapper is a silenced longarm SMG fairly early in the game with an extended mag and a flashy paint job.
Kolt & Associates 556

https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pUr6XUELBco6K3vJMjYR3j-1920-80.png

This Duke Carbine variant doesn't have a suppressor but it is quite high accuracy for a full auto assault rifle with a heavy stock and 7" pistol barrel mod. The Kolt 556 is easier to smash and grab than the Scrapper, though. You've got to fight in and out of the Kolt stash house, but it's a small joint so it's not too hard to get away clean. It's in a gun case on a kitchen table near the safe full of pills.

others.title: 索尼将像 GTA 6 一样支持《巫师 4》的营销

content.v: CD Projekt Red has announced that just today, November 24, the Polish studio signed new deals with Sony Interactive Entertainment for The Witcher 4 's upcoming marketing campaign, among other efforts.

CFO Piotr Nielubowicz told investors that the deals cover CD Projekt Red's games on PlayStation and in the PlayStation Plus catalog, as well as "our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign."
“This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years," he said, according to VGC .
No specifics were made available, but the partnership for The Witcher 4's marketing campaign has people theorizing that it could be similar to Rockstar's co-marketing deal with Sony for GTA 6.

Under that agreement, GTA 6 was marketed as a game that "plays best on PS5," even if the jury is out on that being true . Sony also created special GTA 6 DualSense controllers and even custom consoles for NBA players. The PlayStation branding was prioritized over Xbox to give people the impression that they should get it on PlayStation.

The Witcher 4 is in the works now and is expected to launch in 2028 for console and PC. The game kicks off a new trilogy of The Witcher games, which will also include The Witcher 5 and The Witcher 6. These will all be released within a six-year window, so the whole new trilogy could be out by 2034.
The studio is “targeting” a 2028 release for The Witcher 4, so it could be delayed like The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 were before it.

items.title: 如何在 GTA 6 中偷走豹猫的不流血颈静脉
items.summary: Where to find the car wanted by Randy.

content.v: One of the cars Randy wants in GTA 6 is the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular—and don't let the name fool you, its a slick and speedy ride that'll you'll be tempted to keep for yourself.

But Randy doesn't know the locations of many of the cars on his wishlist, and can't point you to the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular: you just need to keep an eye out for it. Luckily, we spotted it ourselves, so just follow the simple steps below to find it.
Ocelot Bloodless Jugular location
Head to Belville : It's a town in Leonard County, in the central eastern part of the map, a bit south of Lake Leonida and north of La Perle.

In the northern edge of Belville there's a little cluster of four homes laid out almost in an X pattern. The southernmost home of that cluster has a garage you can break into. Once you open the garage door, you'll see the white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular.

You'll need the key cloner to get in, which I assume you already have since you're doing jobs for Randy. No need to worry about the tracker , it's a standard one so it won't transmit your location to the cops. You still don't want to dawdle, because the owner of the car has a gun and he's not afraid to use it. He'll start shooting if he sees you boost the car.
Randy will pay you $10,615 for the Ocelot Bloodless Jugular. He'll pay an extra $5,000 if you bring it to him in pristine condition.

items.title: GTA 6 获得基于游戏内收藏品的官方授权集换式卡牌
items.summary: Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the hunt for GTA 6 trading cards to life.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta6cards-1795544757077.jpg
The hunt for GTA 6 trading cards is leaving the virtual confines of Leonida — Rockstar is teaming up with Panini America to bring the in-game collectibles to life.

The officially licensed GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection is based on Panini’s standard sports card system, featuring rare-numbered cards and team color parallels. The GTA collection adds Vice City-specific Silver, Pink, Teal, and Light Blue parallels to the standard slate of Legend Bronze, Silver, and Gold.
The collectible company has revealed images of several cards planned for the collaboration, which is set to launch this December.

The Panini Group is an Italian-based collectible company that’s become quite the household name for sports card fans. Panini America is the official collectible partner for leagues like the WNBA, NASCAR, and FIFA, just to name a few.

GTA 6 cards will be released in four-pack boxes, each of which, on average, come with two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated, and four Special Silvers. There’s no word on pricing, but hobby boxes currently listed on Panini’s site start at $30 and go up to over $700.

Panini’s card images, shown above, feature a collection of fictional athletes from Vice City’s sports teams. Not all of the featured athletes are entirely fake — for instance, Tyreek Hill, ex-wide receiver for the Miami Dolphins, serves as the voice and likeness for the Vice City Manatees’ Maleek Rivers.

GTA 6 features a total of 480 trading cards across 16 individual sets, and we don't know exactly how many Panini is planning to turn into real cardboard. The sports-focused collectible company is less likely to adapt the collectible cards featuring other GTA 6 characters like Mandy and Vicki , but social media users can hope.
@PaniniAmerica @RockstarGames We want the Mandy card

GTA 6 was officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, and PlayStation just released a fresh batch of jaw-dropping player data . We considered the game a masterpiece in our 10/10 review , with Luke Reilly calling it "the single most impressive video game I have ever played."

Rockstar has gone all out on bringing the already very realistic Vice City to life , and a lot of the action has been happening in the world of sports. Rockstar took over Kaseya Center on the day of GTA 6's launch, with the Miami Heat donning Vice City jerseys for their game against the Milwaukee Bucks.

items.title: 由《Apex Legends》前领导人创立的工作室将在未发布游戏的情况下关闭
items.summary: Gravity Well, founded in 2020 as an "anti-crunch" game studio, lost its funding earlier this year and wasn't a

content.v: Gravity Well, an "anti-crunch" studio founded in 2020 by former Apex Legends executive producer Drew McCoy and lead software engineer Jon Shiring, is entering "hibernation" after losing funding for its game.

Gravity Well's launch in 2020 came with high hopes. Founded by veterans of Call of Duty, Titanfall, and Apex Legends, it made the health of the team "an absolute top priority," McCoy said at the time.

"That means we are anti-crunch. That means good compensation. That means everyone at Gravity Well has creative freedom, because when someone else makes all of the decisions, work isn't fun and the end product isn't as good."

But like so many other ambitious new studios launched around that time, it fell victim to the post-pandemic retrenchment and has effectively shuttered without releasing a game. The shutdown comes just a month after the studio laid off more than 40 people in what it said was a "fight for survival" caused by the loss of funding. It also warned that "given the current state of the industry our future is uncertain."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bgumEMXqpmMuuQDQVMWVdc-1920-80.jpg
A message now posted on the Gravity Well website (via RPS ) says the funding situation hasn't changed, and "sadly the time has come for Gravity Well to go into hibernation."

"We don’t exactly know what is next for us or Gravity Well, but we do know we still believe in the IP and game we were building," the message states. "Even moreso, the team we managed to cultivate was truly world class and we're going to miss getting to work with them every day. If you're a hiring manager or recruiter and a Gravity Well resume hits your desk they come with our highest recommendation."
The announcement concludes with an invitation to publishers and investors to reach out if they're interested in supporting the project.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远最好的增益现在按预期工作
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs,

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended.

World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest.

Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP.

Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed.

That has finally been fixed in the latest update, so players can now enter dungeons with World Buffs to help maximize their damage and health. This should be particularly useful for doing dungeons at a slightly lower level than is intended, as the extra HP and melee haste is definitely noticable.

Blizzard clarified in the patch notes that World Buffs will still be removed when entering raids, so players won't be able to stack as many World Buffs as possible before raid night, as was the case in previous versions of classic WoW.

Other changes found in the patch notes include a fix for an Uldaman boss that players were exploiting to make fast gold. Another is a fix for "a few spells and abilities" that were causing more weapon-proc effects than intended, likely nerfing the DPS of whatever classes were taking advantage of the bug. You can read the full patch notes below.

Blizzard recently outlined in the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast how it wants to get rid of the idea of "best-in-slot gear," as well as how the game's has overhauled old-school WoW's player-vs.-player systems . In other Forever news, the game's launch has seen more than 15 million characters created so far, with the highest weekly player numbers for WoW in 15 years .

items.title: 海岸奇才队起诉印刷假《万智牌》卡牌的网站，指控其进行假冒操作
items.summary: For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxie

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/07/10/ign-mtglobstercheflead-1752163435885.jpg

For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxies and counterfeits has also grown. And now, Wizards of the Coast is suing PrintMTG, alleging a counterfeiting ring for the trading card game.

Wizards of the Coast filed the lawsuit (via Aftermath ) in its home state of Washington, alleging PrintMTG "operate as a complex and sophisticated network (...) engaged in trademark infringement, counterfeiting and criminal copyright infringement on a grand scale." Wizards seeks $28.65 million in damages.

For the most part, PrintMTG was a destination for people to print proxies, or essentially fake Magic cards that could stand in for real ones, for either playtesting or trying before you buy the actual card. And, thanks to the Reserved list, there are plenty of cards that cost thousands of dollars for a legitimate copy, so it's easy to see why going to a website and spending $0.75 on a proxy version instead was a popular choice.

In its complaint, Wizards of the Coast seems to acknowledge the purpose that proxies serve, saying "an honest proxy is a stand-in for a real card that makes no claim to authenticity by appearance or otherwise. Though proxies are prohibited in all sanctioned Magic events, Wizards recognizes that private and noncommercial proxying is a vehicle players can use to further engage with the game, not to undermine it." But, it seems PrintMTG proxies were a bit too realistic.

Later on in the complaint, Wizards of the Coast describes what it sees as a legitimate proxy, which "include writing the name of a card in marker on a basic land card or on a blank card printed for this purpose, using one genuine card to represent another or sliding a slip of notebook paper into a card sleeve." PrintMTG and other proxy-printing websites like it, will instead print Magic's art on card stock, for a price.

Wizards of the Coast alleges that PrintMTG's proxies "directly harm Wizards by displacing sales of genuine cards" and damages "retail partners who sell those cards." But even beyond that, the company alleges that these counterfeits were "creating instability and uncertainty in the very secondary markets third-party retailers rely on as a revenue center."

There's a whole Reddit community that's sprung up, /r/RealOrNotTCG , where people post pictures of Magic cards to try and figure out if they're, well, real or not. However, PrintMTG is just one of many services that print realistic Magic proxies. This is a market that's been around for years, and it seems like Wizards of the Coast is finally cracking down on it.
This lawsuit comes after Wizards of the Coast recently changed the way booster packs work, and ahead of Darkhold Destiny, its third Marvel set.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-ign-1795542340689.jpg

Strip Clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6 , and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs.

"I’m fascinated with the attention to detail from Rockstar," said the head choreographer, Brooke Wilde. "I spent hours in Jack of Hearts and Delights Cabaret, mastering each performance to bring back to Spearmint, and now obsessed gamers can put down their controllers, get out of the bedroom, and experience their favourite virtual lap dances with the Spearmint Rhino girls in the real world. While the in-game strip clubs are addictive, nothing beats the real thing.”

While we can't be sure exactly how many people are reaching out to their local strip joints for IRL GTA-inspired bodily contact, you have to respect the hustle. It's also an interesting counterpoint given GTA 6's impact on another part of the adult entertainment industry, with Mashable reporting that Pornhub saw a 15.5% drop an hour after the game was released on November 19.

Spearmint Rhino's relationship with the series actually goes back to 2013 and GTA 5, when Rockstar used a play on the name of the clubs, Vanilla Rhino, and Rockstar has said that developers for GTA 6 visited strip clubs in Miami and Florida (where Spearmint Rhino has one of its venues) for research purposes.

In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia can both go to strip clubs either together as a couple or individually, and can opt-in for VIP lap dances. As explained in our GTA 6 sex and romance guide , you can throw money at dancers, and if you throw most of your money at one dancer they will remove some of their clothes.

“While gamers across the world immerse themselves in virtual worlds, demand for authentic real-world experiences has never been higher and we’ve had hundreds of inquiries from GTA 6 fans," explained the company president and COO, Kathy Vercher.

"Strip clubs are such an iconic feature in the franchise, and Spearmint Rhino is uniquely positioned to create a real-world experience for gamers. Thanks to the dedication of our Chief Choreographer, Brooke, we’ve been able to bring the in-game lap dance experience into our venues worldwide, with such accuracy that gamers are guaranteed to get a mindblowing real-life experience.”

items.title: Take-Two 严厉打击让游戏在 PC 上运行的非法行为，《GTA 6》重制版领导者退出
items.summary: The leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recreate GTA 6 on PC, have quit the project, althou

content.v: Just a day after Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the near-complete Xbox build of the game they dropped on Friday, at least two of the leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recompile it to run on PC, have called it quits—seemingly under pressure from Take-Two and Rockstar.

The release of the exe made the pirated Xbox build effectively complete, and that opened the door for recomp projects to do their thing—that is, to leverage AI to quickly whip up a version of the game that will run on PC. Some hackers estimated it could be done within a week; Shayder, one of the lead developers on the Leonida project, said on X that followers could "expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon."

In a separate message on the Leonida Discord, Shayder tempered expectations a bit, writing that "it will take at least a week" to come up with something playable on PC. During a subsequent livestream, however, the team was seemingly able to get the GTA 6 splash screen to come up on PC, although it crashed after that. It sure seemed like things were moving ahead quickly.

But then things began moving quickly in a different direction. "I quit guys. I’m sorry," NotRexed, apparently the head of the project, posted last night on X . "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can’t control so I’m stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity."

Later, they added , "Last post from me. I wanna clear things up. Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I’ve said before, I’m a 15 year old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s6VhP2q79EgtSq3d7AamJk-1920-80.png
In a reply post, NotRexed stated explicitly that "Rockstar shut the server down," and shared an image of the copyright violation notice he'd received from Discord.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2vMmWbeyPsdLfRRf5BVmMk-1920-80.png
Shayder, who had previously predicted rapid progress on the Leonida effort following the release of the Xbox executable, took a more direct approach and simply deleted all of their X posts.

This isn't necessarily the end of work to bring GTA 6 (in a probably not-great state) to PC via AI. Other such projects are underway, and there also appears to be an effort to carry on with Leonida: The website remains up, with a new name attached as owner, and there's at least one Discord server dedicated to it, although it appears a little less focused at this point than the original Leonida server. A new Github repository (NotRexed also deleted that) has been set up: It's "a continuation of NotRexed's Leonida project," according to a note on the project, which adds that "development continues here with its full commit history."

The advent of AI greatly simplifies and speeds up the work of bringing console games to PC (as long as you're not too picky about the quality), and that makes life tougher for companies that want to keep a lid on such projects. Still, it's not surprising that Take-Two and Rockstar are going hard on it: In the past, Take-Two has moved aggressively to shut down GTA 5 mod projects, an effort that culminated in its acquisition of the biggest and best of them . I've reached out to Take-Two for more information on the takedown and will update if I receive a reply.

Handgun Hold Power Button to aim, then press Attack Button to fire a single round. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors.
Flail Hold Power Button to wield the Flail , then press Attack Button to strike. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors.
5m range.
Strikes over Window vaults, Pallets, and short objects.

Bike Horn Hold Power Button to ready, then press Attack Button to squeeze the Bike Horn, detecting Survivors within a 6m radius and an unlimited forward range. A detected Survivor is revealed by a loud noise notification. If multiple Survivors are detected, they are afflicted with Oblivious and Killer Instinct reveals their locations. When a Tortured Survivor is detected, the duration of their affliction is reset. Unlike other Toys, the Bike Horn 's Deadliness increases when it detects multiple Survivors. At maximum Deadliness , detected Survivors who are repairing or healing have their interactions interrupted with an instant 5% regression to repair progress and 5% regression to healing progress.

Toys damage healthy Survivors and inflict injured Survivors with Torture . Hit a Tortured Survivor with a different Toy to down them. Inflicting Torture increases a Toy 's Deadliness by 1 point. At maximum Deadliness , a Toy both injures and inflicts Torture on a healthy Survivor and downs injured Survivors. However, the amount of points for all other Toys to reach maximum Deadliness increases by 1.
The Torture affliction lasts for 40s, or until the Survivor returns to a healthy state or is downed.

The duration of Torture is reset when hit by the same Toy . SPECIAL ACTION: TAUNT When a different Toy hits a Tortured Survivor, they are downed and afflicted with Terrified . Tap Ability Button within 6m of a Terrified Survivor in the dying state to Taunt them, increasing the Deadliness of all Toys by 1 point. This removes the Survivor’s Terrified state. Hooked Survivors will be automatically Taunted .
New Killer Perks:
Laughingstock :
Survivors within 12m of a completed Generator:
Gain Exhausted .
Gain Oblivious .
When they leave this range, the effect lingers for 3/4/5s .
You see the Auras of completed Generators.
Kill Spree :
When all remaining Survivors have 2 Hook States and all Generators are completed, you can kill Survivors.
While killing a Survivor, both Exit Gate Switches are blocked. Whenever you finish killing a Survivor, this ends after 12/16/20s .
Funny Business :
Whenever you damage a Generator, you gain 10% Haste for 10s and one of the following occurs at random:
You retain your 10% Haste for 5s longer.
You get stunned for 2s .
The affected Generator is blocked for 30s .
Confetti! But nothing happens.
Cooldown: 60/50/40s .
The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.
New Survivor Perks:
Valkyrie's Rage :
After being chased for 40/35/30s , the next time you pallet-stun the Killer, they are stunned for 75% longer.
Shared Trauma :
Whenever you take a protection hit, all Survivors within 12m recover from Exhausted while running for 30/35/40s .
Within 32m , you see the Auras of Exhausted Survivors.
Best Gift Ever :
At the start of the trial, you earn 4/5/6 Tokens .
The first time you drop an Item of each type, spend 1 Token , then the dropped item is consumed (by the Entity). Then, based on the item type:
Flashlight - Whenever you stun the Killer, they are also blinded for 2s .
Fog Vial - Whenever you fast-vault, for 5s , your scratch marks disappear 50% faster.

items.title: 与三个月前相比，《巫师 4》的开发人员有所减少，但也只是勉强维持
items.summary: As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projec

content.v: As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projects and headcount.

For the quarter that ended on October 31, The Witcher 4 was the company's biggest project by headcount, with 513 people working on it. That's down from 519 people for the quarter that ended on July 31.

For comparison, the number of developers on Cyberpunk 2 rose from 184 to 199 and staffers on the new IP codenamed Hadar jumped from 33 to 34. The codename Sirius game, believed to be a multiplayer The Witcher game, saw its development staff shrink from 84 to 60; the project has undergone numerous shifts throughout its development as CD Projekt reworks the experience.
CD Projekt's total development headcount rose from 1,045 to 1,051.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Screenshot-2026-11-24-at-11.29.46-AM.png

In terms of money , CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN ($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD).

CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet. The company is also working on a game with Scopely , the mobile gaming giant owned by Saudi Arabia.
Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good .

items.summary: Symphonic.

content.v: Four years ago (oh my god) strategy RPG Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga rather impressed our reviewer Jon Bolding. He wrote that "novel tactical mechanics make this indie a contender for the best strategy RPG this year".

Well, buckle up, 2027, because Symphony of War 2 has broken cover with a promise to release next year, and it's coming courtesy of the strategy sommeliers at publisher Hooded Horse, which I take as a very good sign.

SOW2 looks set to continue the Fire-Emblem-ish framework of its predecessor, tasking you with recruiting a gaggle of heroes to wage war with (and possibly compose symphonies, who's to say?) in "a world filled with political intrigue, betrayal, and tense, large-scale tactical battles". Which is a lot like our world, really.

It all looks very nice indeed. In the announcement trailer, we get glimpses of its squad-based combat and anime cutscenes, and I am officially into both. The art is poppy and distinctive, at some point an age-of-sail warship transforms into some kind of German WW1 destroyer, and the overworld triggers the regions in my brain devoted to thinking about Heroes of Might and Magic. Check, check, and check.

"Anime cutscenes!?" I hear you cry. "That sounds like the kind of thing that bespeaks a dense tapestry of lore I'll need to get to grips with first!" Well, apparently not. I am informed by Symphony of War 2's Steam page that the devs have no expectation you know what a "Nephilim Saga" even is before you pick this game up. "Symphony of War 2 is a standalone experience set several generations after the events of the first game—it can be enjoyed without having played Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga". The game's tale of a fallen empire trying to un-fall can be enjoyed single-serve .

items.title: GTA 6 之所以伟大，是因为其中所有凶残的 NPC，而不是无视他们
items.summary: Nobody wants to work for their crimes anymore, smh.

content.v: It's come to my attention that some of us aren't having a very fun time with the NPCs in Grand Theft Auto 6 . I've seen videos and threads of players complaining about not being able to steal cars because of crack head drivers , getting hunted down by killer NPCs , and just generally having a harder time traversing Leonida because who knows what bloodthirsty beast hides behind each corner? And to this I say, your steak is too buttery? Your lobster too juicy?

My first interaction with one of the unfriendly residents of Leonida started when I accidentally bumped into their car. Because I am wholly unaware of my surroundings, I didn't even notice that anyone was mad at me as I listened to my pop songs and carried on driving towards my mission. Little did I know that right behind me was a four-wheeler with a driver who had steam coming out of her ears.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FHpHsCT6pgzsfWhK6a7ou7-1920-80.png

So I pull up to the side of the road, ready to head in and start my mission, when seemingly out of nowhere the four-wheeler comes barreling in, almost taking me out completely. The driver gets out and starts screaming about payback. I have no idea what I've done, but this is GTA 6, I'm not taking this slander. So I start swinging.

The fight ends with me knocking this lady out, but she doesn't go down without a fight. At one point, I actually thought that was it for me—taken out on the pavement by a soccer mum, what a way to go.
But even if I had taken a long sleep on the sidewalk, that would've been OK, because it's all part of the beautiful package that GTA 6 offers.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QamfnYwDrXhvrAsUare8DD-1920-80.jpg

I don't want vapid NPCs that buckle at the first sight of a handgun, or have the object permanence of a goldfish. Filling Leonida with some actually competent, and dare I say dangerous NPCs makes this game infinitely more interesting. I like not knowing how one small action will ruin my whole day, or having to be a little wary of the people around me lest I want to incur a murderous chase across the city streets.
Terrorising helpless NPCs is fun, but only for a short while.

I have a theory as to why players are pushing back against aggressive NPCs: they just don't like having to put in the effort after years of being able to do whatever they want in GTA Online. There's certainly some that will look back on the mostly timid NPCs of Los Santos and miss when all they had to do to steal a car was swing open its door and throw the limp driver out. Aside from shouting, there wasn't really anything a regular NPC could do to pose a threat to you back then.

Rockstar amped up the mayhem and carnage you could cause, turning it into a chaotic playground with few repercussions. GTA Online players have become accustomed to walking around like some vengeful god, wreaking havoc wherever or whenever they see fit, and only very occasionally dealing out mercy. Now these fickle deities have been forced to become human again.
A part of me understands the appeal. Terrorising helpless NPCs is fun, but only for a short while. NPCs that actually have a backbone offer an experience that will keep me interested for far longer.
Plus, Leonida is based on Florida, do you honestly think you could terrorise the streets of Miami or Tampa Bay and walk out completely unscathed? Yeah, I thought as much.

items.title: GTA 6 给 Pornhub 带来了困难
items.summary: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen

content.v: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material.

According to Mashable , US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later.

Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low.

Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office , as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

For more GTA 6 news, you can read up on how modders are attempting to make an unofficial PC port , how to fix GTA 6's broken HDR , and you can check out our list of walkthroughs in the GTA 6 guides hub .
